jobs.title: Business Development Director
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The jobholder will work closely with Regional Head of Sales, Segment heads, and their own team to drive Strategic and Tactical initiatives (GDP), manage the marketing team, ensure integration and utilization of business optimization tools, and generally support the sales management team. The position will ensure GDP initiatives are organized and executed monthly and facilitate the data collection of the required TTI’s. Regional marketing will prioritize activities that are in alignment with these initiatives.

Business excellence processes and tools (Salesforce, CPQ, etc.) will be supported by driving adoption and execution of the tools monitoring utilization and escalating any roadblocks or lack of adoption issues as well as overseeing new product order entry management. A background in LEAN/VBSS or similar is considered beneficial to identify opportunities to simplify business processes especially from an internal efficiency and/or customer perspective. Targeted location: Within traveling distance of Easley, SC

Main accountabilities and tasks

• Organize and support the GDP initiatives

• Partner with the segment heads to develop, track, and report on the various action plans

• Work with business analyst personnel to automate the collection of TTI data

• Collect and communicate performance data, market insights, and opportunities to assist sales teams and services (collect KPI’s, structure data, visual management, etc.)

• Coordinate Regional marketing managers’ activities

• Combine marketing promotion, analytics, and GDP/initiatives together to coordinate and focus resources

• Oversee management of marketing communication and Marketing Initiatives

• Support channel partners development programs

• Support sales leadership to create and manage the communication flow on the main social internal and external

• Focus on execution and waste removal in business processes, primarily in Sales and Service activities Drive Sales Support department providing data intelligence to sales leaders to facilitate businesses.

• Organize and oversee data mining, accessibility to data in various systems (ERPs)

• Management level dashboard creation and maintenance

• Support Business Intelligence data collection and Analysis.

• Coordinate with other functions that SalesForce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf and other main systems are developed according to business requirements.

• Liaise with Finance and with Strategy (Budgeting Process, by Segment, by Region, by Product)

• Regular Pipeline Review and CRM maintenance

• Trainer for SalesForce

• Rolling Forecast management, both for OI (Order Intake) and Sales

• Partner with sales leaders and corporate business development personnel to track timely execution of key tasks

• Assist with preparation for corporate presentations and reports

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: National Sales Manager PPI
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role leads and develops Direct and Regional Sales Managers, implements sales strategies, and supports the Pulp and Paper market. This position has direct accountability for all PPI sales activities, both direct and indirect, in the USA. This role will necessitate effective collaboration and coordination with operations, procurement, quality, and other relevant departments. Essential Functions:

• Achieve sales growth targets by developing and executing annual sales plans.

• Lead the RSM’s, monitor individual performance against goals, and provide coaching, mentoring, and training.

• Responsible for ownership and personal management of the direct corporate accounts. Develops trust and solid partnerships with Corporate and OEM accounts. Negotiates and manages agreements with both.

• Engages collaboratively with technical associations and partners with leading technical universities.

• Analyze and identify market trends, and the competition to jointly develop strategic plans for expanding sales of new and existing products.

• Travel, as necessary within the assigned territory.

Other Duties:

• Must possess superior presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Experience with multiple direct reports and a proven history of leading teams.

• Superior analytical, strategic thinking, leadership skills.

• Demonstrated success through focus, good judgment, and decision-making.

• Keen sense of teamwork and business goal alignment.

• Well-developed sense of urgency to deliver results.

• Excellent relationship and people skills.

Supervisory Duties:

• Network of Regional Sales Managers and Application Specialists covering the PPI market.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a similar technical degree preferred. MBA is a plus.

• At least 10-15 years’ regional sales experience.

• At least 5 years people management experience.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

jobs.title: IT Apprentice (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The IT Jr. Support is responsible for performing basic IT support tasks such as setting up equipment, assisting users, and following standard procedures. This role works under supervision and supports routine IT operations. This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.
Key Responsibilities

• Assist with hardware and software setup and configuration.

• Provide basic technical support to users.

• Follow standard procedures for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

• Maintain IT equipment and workspace organization.

• Escalate issues to senior support staff as needed.

• Skills & Qualifications

• May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Qualifications

• Basic understanding of IT hardware and software.

• Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

• Good communication and teamwork skills.

• Familiarity with Microsoft Office is a plus.

A requirement is that you will take part in the BBL program "ICT Support Technician" or "ICT system engineer" in Nijmegen (ROC), Arnhem (Rijn IJssel), or Breda (Curio). You attend school one day a week and work four days at our company.

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area.
Principais Responsabilidades

• Gerenciar, acompanhar e executar projetos e atividades de alta complexidade relacionados à área de Qualidade;

jobs.title: Receptionist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Administrator is responsible for providing basic administrative support by following established procedures. This role works under close supervision and handles routine tasks to support office operations.

Will answer phones, greet and check in all visitors.

This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and work under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. SC: Phoenix, Arizona

PRIMARY FUNCTIONS:

• Upon arriving make sure necessary lights are on and the TV with the safety message is turned on

• Answer / screen / forward incoming phone calls using a multi-line telephone system

• Personably greet and welcome walk-in customers / visitors; ensure they are signed in accordingly then direct them to the appropriate staff member

• Direct visitors to the appropriate person and office

• Ensure reception desk is manned and the main telephone line has coverage at all times during business hours

• Perform brief safety orientation accordingly with customers / visitors entering the premises, where applicable

• Manage inventory and purchase office supplies

• Create and maintain inventory spreadsheet for admin and sales supplies

• Manage and update the conference room calendar as needed

• Organize, set-up, break down and maintain conference room for all operations and executive meetings

• Organize and order lunch on an as needed basis

• Oversee sorting and distribution of mail to both the administration and shop buildings

• Prepare outgoing mail / UPS / FedEx (envelopes, packages, etc.)

• Perform other clerical receptionist duties such a filing, photocopying, data entry, etc.

• Keep common area clean and organized

• Provide assistance to other departments as needed and per supervisor approval

EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

• Knowledge and proficient use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point

• Maintain a professional attitude and appearance

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Customer service quality

• Independently perform substantial clerical and office work

• The ability to proficiently use a multi-line telephone system, computer, copier and other office equipment

• Be a self-motivated individual with initiative and the ability to multi-task

• Team oriented and able to interact with multiple departments

• Bilingual is required (English & Spanish)

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

• Office environment

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• May occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Schlüsselrolle verantworten Sie den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt. Sie betreuen bestehende Kunden, identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und begleiten Projekte von der ersten Kundenansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für den Vertrieb technisch anspruchsvoller Lösungen im deutschen Markt

• Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie aktive Neukundengewinnung

• Steuerung des gesamten Vertriebsprozesses von der Erstansprache bis zum Vertragsabschluss

• Aufbau und Pflege einer belastbaren Sales-Pipeline inklusive Forecasting und CRM-Management

• Technische und kaufmännische Beratung von Kunden sowie Übersetzung von Anforderungen in passgenaue Lösungen

• Durchführung von Kundenbesuchen, Präsentationen und Produkt- bzw. Lösungsdemonstrationen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Service-, Projektmanagement- und Produktteams

• Unterstützung bei Angebotskalkulationen, technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungen

• Analyse von Markt‑, Wettbewerbs- und Technologietrends sowie Einbringen von Marktfeedback

• Mitwirkung an Vertriebsplanung, Zieldefinition und strategischen Vertriebsthemen

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z. B. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen) oder kaufmännischer Hintergrund mit starker technischer Expertise

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in Energie, Schwerindustrie, Oil & Gas oder Power Generation

• Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Spezifikationen

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations‑ und Verhandlungsstärke sowie hohe Kundenorientierung

• Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und starke Abschlussorientierung

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

• Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets sowie gelegentlich international

What we offer you

• Mitarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld mit enger Zusammenarbeit mit Technik und Engineering

• Attraktives Gesamtpaket mit fixem Gehalt und leistungsbezogenen Bonusanteilen

• Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung und zum Ausbau der eigenen Vertriebsexpertise

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager is responsible for managing a team of sales representatives, setting sales goals, and ensuring the team meets performance targets. This role supports the execution of sales strategies and provides coaching and development to team members.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ experienced to senior expert-level employees.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and support the sales team in achieving targets.
Set sales goals and monitor performance metrics.
Train and mentor sales representatives.
Develop and implement sales plans and strategies.
Handle key customer accounts and resolve escalations.
Collaborate with marketing and operations teams.
Report sales performance to senior leadership.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and 9+ years of relevant work experienceare minimally required to be able to manage and coordinate one or more expert-level teams.
Experience in sales team management.
Strong leadership and coaching skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in CRM systems and reporting tools.
Ability to analyze data and drive performance.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

jobs.title: Order Entry & Tendering
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Bajo la posición de Orden entry & tendering, el Especialista en Entrada de Órdenes es responsable de ingresar, gestionar y dar seguimiento a todas las órdenes de materiales y servicios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares establecidos, así como de las directivas, procedimientos de trabajo y políticas vigentes de la compañía.
Adicionalmente, colabora en la generación de cotizaciones, brinda apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas y, previa solicitud, realiza otras tareas relacionadas acordes a su función. Responsabilidades:

• Gestionar los pedidos de clientes desde la recepción de la orden hasta su correcta facturación.

• Asegurar la conciliación de los pedidos recibidos con las cotizaciones previamente emitidas o con las listas de precios vigentes.

• Ejecutar y controlar todas las funciones asociadas a la entrada de pedidos y facturación, incluyendo aquellos relacionados con la fabricación de productos para clientes.

• Realizar la entrada de pedidos en SAP, manteniendo comunicación permanente y coordinando la planificación con el equipo de ventas, hasta su facturación.

• Elaborar cotizaciones comerciales, asegurando el correcto uso de precios, condiciones comerciales y políticas internas.

• Brindar apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas, incluyendo gestión documental, actualización de información en sistemas, apoyo en informes y coordinación interna.

• Elaborar y presentar informes de ventas periódicos.

• Demostrar habilidad para seguir métodos y procedimientos establecidos, trabajo en equipo, criterio profesional, atención al detalle y capacidad de comunicación clara y concisa, tanto oral como escrita.

• Asegurar la correcta calidad de la información comercial y contractual en SAP, cumpliendo con políticas internas y estándares de compliance.

• Apoyar análisis básicos de ventas, backlog y desempeño comercial, contribuyendo a la mejora continua de los procesos.

• Coordinar con fábrica y logística para validar fechas de entrega, disponibilidad y condiciones de despacho

• Colaborar en iniciativas de mejora continua en procesos de order entry, cotizaciones y tendering.

Requisitos:

• Técnico de Nivel Superior o Universitario

• 5 años mínimos de experiencia previa contrastable en posición similar

• Tener habilidades sociales y capacidad para resolver problemas en un grupo de trabajo

• Manejo de idiomas español e inglés, competencias completas.

• Dedicación (aprender, adaptar, gestionar), Disposición y Compromiso.

• Buen conocimiento del entorno informático, incluido SAP y la suite Office.

What we offer you

Beneficios:

• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.

• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro médico y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Technical Representative
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role involves providing engineering troubleshooting & solutions. Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts. Manage internal and external subcontracted work. Develop repair specifications, drawings, forms, and processes. Including support project management
Technical Representative

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:
Responsible for all technical information and specifications for each project including:
• Repair specifications, Inspection forms, drawings / prints, material specifications
• Respond to internal requests for inspection and budgetary repair work scopes
• Issue inspection work scopes and estimates
• Review inspection results and evaluate repair solutions
• Write repair work scopes and submit estimates
• Maintain/update repair and inspection service profile templates
• Provide engineering troubleshooting & solutions
• Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Engineering degree or at least 4 years’ experience in turbo machinery.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Jerome Blalack at Jerome.Blalack@sulzer.com or Hiring Manager – Billy Bottera.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A machinist needs to have manual dexterity, and eye for detail, knowledge of mathematics and mechanics, and respect for safety precautions.

Position Summary:

A Machinist is a professional that uses different techniques to create and make very precise metal parts. A machinist should be able to operate and maintain industrial machines, produce precision tools, interpret technical drawings and instructions, and ensure safety and quality standards. A machinist also needs to have manual dexterity, and eye for detail, knowledge of mathematics and mechanics, and respect for safety precautions.

Responsibilities:

Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Machine personnel, Supervisor, and Lead Man
Capable of setting up & operating all machines in the shop (including large mills, lathes, tool post grinders, and other equipment)
Operate manual and automatic feeds to 0.0002” as required for final cuts
Complete assigned jobs start to finish with little or no supervision. This includes the ability to perform the following:
Read blueprints, drawings and sketches that may require intermediate math and problems solving skills to calculate dimensions not specified on print.
Have and maintain ability to use and operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts
Maintain LEAN objectives within the department

Qualifications:

The ideal candidate will possess the following:

Experience as a Manual machinist
Experience with both CNC with manual experience
Field machinist Manual Machinist

Work hours are subject to change & will be determined by workload and shift coverage needs. Typically, Day Shift will start at 5:00AM or 7am and end at 3:30PM; Typically, Night Shift will start at 3:30PM and will end at 12am or 2am.

jobs.title: Rotor Balance Tech
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Possess professional tools to adequately perform daily assignments. Be proficient with the required hand tools & measuring devices. Ability to operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts. Inspect, Disassemble and Reassemble all rotating elements for gas turbines. Rotor Balance Tech

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Possess professional tools to adequately perform daily assignments. Be proficient with the required hand tools & measuring devices. Ability to operate the overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts.

• Inspect, Disassemble and Reassemble all rotating elements for Gas turbines.

• Read/interpret indicators accurately within .0001”. Read and understand the required technical information for the job. Properly complete all associated documentation required for their assignments.

• Continuously develop knowledge of products, materials, and procedures to better perform duties. Complete company-required training programs .

• Communicate with co-workers, leads & supervisor on projects. Work well with other employees. Follow company Safety, Quality Policies, and ISO procedures.

• Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the schedule time . Keep work area clear and well organized during all phases of the project

• Comply with the requirements of risk assessments and safety procedures. Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Mechanical aptitude, reliability, integrity, teamwork & strong work ethic.

• Rotating equipment experience is preferred but not required.

• Balance experience is preferred but not required.

• Willing to work overtime.

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Responsabilidades:

• Responsable de realizar presentaciones a los clientes con el fin de asesorar, formar y promocionar nuestros productos y servicios, relacionados con los procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales (bombas y mixers sumergibles, aireadores, trituradoras, tamices, decantadores, filtros).

• Trabajar de manera multidisciplinaria con los otros departamentos para preparar planes de ventas y ofertas, garantizando la precisión técnica y financiera.

• Trabajar con el equipo de ventas en general para identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de mercado.

• Establecer y mantener relaciones efectivas con los clientes, comprender sus necesidades y promover la comprensión por parte del cliente de nuestra oferta de productos, sistemas y/o servicios.

• Crear valor agregado para el cliente y, a continuación, alinearse para ofrecer una solución, garantizando una experiencia positiva para el cliente.

• Preparar planes de ventas y realizar revisiones periódicas de la situación para mantener los volúmenes de pedidos, y gestionar los procesos administrativos de ventas.

• Promocionar activamente todo el portafolio de productos Sulzer en los mercados asignados.

• Alcanzar o superar los objetivos de venta acordados para el segmento o región.

• Desarrollar e implementar estrategias comerciales consistentes con los objetivos de Sulzer.

• Preparar y acompañar activamente las ofertas para los clientes en las regiones y segmentos asignados.

• Responsable por la proyección precisa de ventas para su región y cuentas relacionadas.

• Revisar órdenes de compra, contratos, términos y condiciones para las cuentas y clientes asignados.

• Preparación de ofertas en coordinación con el departamento de ofertas y propuestas, garantizando que se cumplen los aspectos técnicos y financieros adecuados, incluidos los precios y las condiciones comerciales.

• Visitas constantes a los clientes para desarrollo de nuevos mercados.

• Visitas con clientes importantes y buscar prospectos potenciales.

Requisitos:

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia como ingeniero de ventas y/o ingeniero de aplicaciones en el área de gestión de agua urbana y/o industrial.

• Titulado en ingeniería industrial, mecánica, hidráulica o afín.

• Experiencia en ventas directas e indirectas a clientes industriales.

• Conocimientos sobre procesos de tratamiento de aguas residuales urbanas e industriales, bombas centrífugas y motores eléctricos.

• Cartera de clientes/relaciones existentes en los mercados de industrias y aguas municipales, incluyendo O&M, EPC, empresas de ingeniería y usuarios finales

• Disponibilidad para viajes (50% del tiempo)

• Dominio de Microsoft Office (Excel) y Sales Force.

• Manejo de inglés intermedio.

• Buenas habilidades de comunicación.

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente.

• Proactivo.

• Motivado, con un historial demostrado de obtención de resultados por encima de los objetivos y las expectativas.

What we offer you

Beneficios:

• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.

• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.

• Seguro médico y dental.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce an

jobs.title: SAP Module Consultant (PP/MM)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The IT Specialist is responsible for supporting and maintaining IT systems and infrastructure, ensuring operational efficiency and user satisfaction. This role manages technical projects and provides advanced support across departments. Job Responsibilities

• Design and delivery of SAP solutions that meet business requirement, whilst also ensuring global process and system harmonization.

• Provide 2nd/3rd level support for production incident resolution.

• Provide SAP training to key user/project team.

• Responsible for executing assigned activities including :

• Configuring the SAP system and system documentation.

• Performing system testing.

• Writing functional specifications in the development of RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements & Forms) .

• Maintaining SAP user manuals.

• Developing and supporting SAP integration with other 3rd-party systems.

• Support system upgrades, patches.

• Adoption of best practices & compliance management by developing new SAP tools, features & enhancements.

• Coordinate activities with technical, security and Basis teams.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in technical or business studies.

• Minimum 5 years on working experience in SAP module PP (Production Planning. Knowledge of SAP MM (Material Management) would be a plus.

• Fluent English and Chinese required – other languages are an advantage.

• Good understanding on how to turn the business requirements into an ERP processes.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.
Interpret blueprints, technical drawings, and specifications.
Measure and inspect components using, calipers, dial indicators, etc.
Ensure proper alignment and tolerances are achieved.
Maintain field equipment and tooling.
Communicate with clients and supervisors regarding job progress and issues.

Skills & Qualifications
High school diploma or equivalent technical training.
Proven experience as a machinist, preferably in field or industrial environment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer - Electrical C&I
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures the reliability, optimization, and compliance of control systems and instrumentation at Sulzer. This role supports the design of centrifugal pumps and components, preparing detailed engineering studies, calculations, BOMs and documentation to meet customer and regulatory standards. Through technical expertise and collaboration, the position enhances equipment performance, contributes to operational excellence, and supports Sulzer's mission to deliver innovative fluid engineering solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare accurate engineering electrical drawings, Bills of Materials, and specifications using CAD (EPLAN & AutoCAD) to enable pump manufacturing.

• Perform and validate detailed design calculations to ensure designs meet customer requirements, safety, and quality standards.

• Design and develop customized pump components and assemblies based on customer specifications and company standards.

• Collaborate with internal teams like Sales and Tendering, Project Management, and Manufacturing to support project execution and address technical challenges.

• Supervise and review the work of design engineers and drafters to ensure quality and adherence to timelines.

• Adhere to strict schedule deadlines and ensure timely delivery of all engineering tasks and deliverables.

• Participate in order reviews, design meetings, and administrative functions to support effective project management.

• Contribute to process improvements and uphold EHS and company quality standards in all tasks.

• Participation in customer meetings and site visits to ensure customer satisfaction and provide technical alignment.

• Support and collaborate with other engineering facilities and divisions in the Global Sulzer Organization to ensure on-time delivery and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical ​engineering; CAD or Lean certification is an advantage.

• 5–8 years of relevant work experience in electrical and mechanical design environments.

• Proficiency in electrical CAD design using EPLAN (AutoCAD as a minimum), with solid experience in Teamcenter and SAP.

• Sound knowledge of electrical drafting, manufacturing processes, and detailed calculations for pump components and assemblies.

• Familiarity with LEAN principles, EHS standards, and order execution and handling processes.

• Strong problem-solving skills with proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

• Demonstrated leadership, mentoring capability, excellent time management, and the ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer - Mechanical Fire Water Pump

titleByLocale.it: Senior Design Ingegnere - Mechanical Fire Water Pump
titleByLocale.en: Senior Design Engineer - Mechanical Fire Water Pump
titleByLocale.de: Senior Design Ingenieur - Mechanical Fire Water Pump
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Design Ingénieur - Mechanical Fire Water Pump

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Lead and manage mechanical design projects related to fire water pump systems, from sales order review to production handover. Ensure compliance with Aramco engineering standards, NFPA 20, and other applicable codes. Provide technical leadership in the design, documentation, and execution of fire protection pumping systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret Aramco project specifications and NFPA 20 requirements to develop compliant fire water pump designs.

• Prepare and deliver customer‑facing documents including Pump Cross Section drawings, General Arrangement drawings, P&ID diagrams, and when required, relevant calculations.

• Approve and coordinate buyout component documentation for motors, couplings, seals, gearboxes, valves, and diesel engines.

• Collaborate with instrumentation team to ensure proper integration of fire system controls and monitoring.

• Generate and manage Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP ERP.

• Liaise with customers, Aramco representatives, and sub-suppliers to ensure design alignment and approvals.

• Support cross-functional teams (Operations, Procurement, Quality, Testing) throughout the project lifecycle.

• Provide commissioning support and troubleshooting for fire pump systems at site or on test bed.

• Prepare and submit design calculations and technical reports for client and regulatory approval.

• Ensure designs meet safety, reliability, and performance standards required for fire protection systems.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.

• 5–10 years of experience in centrifugal pump design, with a focus on fire water systems.

• Moderate understanding of both horizontal and vertical pump design and operation.

• Strong working knowledge of NFPA 20, API standards, and Aramco engineering specifications.

• Proficiency in Autodesk (AutoCAD, Inventor), Siemens NX, & Teamcenter.

• Experience with SAP for BOM and project tracking.

• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and interface with clients and regulatory bodies.

• Strong ownership, attention to detail, and results-oriented mindset.

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Lead Architect Data Quality
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role sits at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data governance, and business transformation. The Lead Architect – Data Quality works with business and IT leaders to redesign end-to-end processes and data flows so that high-quality data becomes the default outcome rather than a downstream correction effort.
The position plays a central role in large-scale change initiatives (e.g., ERP modernization, MDM rollout, customer and material master harmonization, PLM integrations), providing a unique opportunity to create lasting architectural impact across Sulzer.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design of enterprise data quality architecture and ensure preventive controls are embedded into processes and systems by default.

• Define and evolve enterprise data models, standards, critical data elements, and validation rules across priority domains (e.g., Customer, Material, Product).

• Drive root-cause elimination initiatives by redesigning processes, system interactions, and data ownership models.

• Define data quality KPIs and maturity tracking; monitor trends, risks, and progress and report transparently to governance bodies and management.

• Act as a key architectural contributor to data-related transformation programs (ERP, CRM, PLM, MDM, integration, analytics).

• Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture and IT leadership to shape future-state data and integration architecture decisions.

• Establish escalation mechanisms aligned with the enterprise data governance framework and enable consistent decision-making across Legal Entities.

• Contribute to evaluation and selection of data quality, governance, and MDM technologies and help define target-state capabilities.

Candidate Profile

• University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data quality, data governance, or related enterprise transformation roles.

• Strong understanding of data quality management and controls, enterprise data flows, integrations, and end-to-end business processes.

• Proven ability to perform root-cause analysis beyond symptoms and drive structural remediation.

• Strong conceptual thinking combined with pragmatic execution and delivery focus.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills in English

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a global industrial, engineering, or manufacturing environment.

• Hands-on exposure to enterprise application landscapes (SAP-centric environments such as S/4HANA/MDG, CRM, PLM, MDM).

• Experience working closely with Enterprise Architects or IT architecture teams.

• Relevant certification in data management, data governance, or architecture.

• Familiarity with modern integration patterns and data platforms (API-led integration, event-driven patterns, data lakes/warehouses) is a plus.

Success Measures

• Recurring data quality issues are reduced through structural, preventive solutions.

• Data quality controls are embedded into business processes and system designs.

• Clear ownership and accountability for data quality issues are established and followed.

• Business and IT teams align on systemic data quality remediation rather than manual fixes.

• Enterprise data architecture decisions consistently reflect data quality and governance requirements

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) de Vendas AM&S
Vendedor Externo de Equipamentos PL
Business Administration Apprentice
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Start your career at Sulzer’s Birmingham HQ Service Centre, the hub of our UK operations and home to world‑class engineering, customer support and service delivery teams. This apprenticeship is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive and eager to learn how a busy technical service centre runs behind the scenes. You’ll gain real administrative experience while supporting the teams that keep major engineering projects moving. Job Responsibilities

• Provide day‑to‑day administrative support to workshop, engineering and management teams.

• Help manage incoming enquiries, emails and phone calls, ensuring they reach the right people promptly.

• Assist with scheduling jobs, creating work orders and updating internal systems.

• Prepare documents, reports and basic spreadsheets to support operational workflows.

• Help maintain accurate records for jobs, parts, orders, and compliance documentation.

• Support purchasing and logistics tasks, such as raising purchase orders and tracking deliveries.

• Assist with reception duties, welcoming visitors and contractors to the service centre.

• Learn to use industry-standard software, internal systems and digital tools.

• Help organise meetings, training sessions and internal events.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by keeping processes and paperwork tidy, accurate and consistent.

Job Qualifications

• 5 GCSEs (or equivalent) at grade 4/C or above, including English and Maths.

• Strong communication skills with a professional, confident approach.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritise tasks.

• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to completing an apprenticeship in administration.

• Eligibility to work in the UK.

What we offer you

• Increasing pay throughout the apprenticeship

• Mentoring and support from expert technicians

• Training and development programme

• Work with new technologies and exciting applications

• Sponsored educational opportunities and pathways to higher education

• Opportunity to complete part of your apprenticeship at another site in the UK

• Opportunity to work abroad with customers all over the world

• Potential for a permanent role with Sulzer upon successful completion of the apprenticeship

• Continuous progression within the company

• Apprentice community of over 80 apprentices across the UK

• 33 days holiday, inclusive of bank holidays

• Pension plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd is part of our Water and Industry Business Unit which aspires to develop - among others - products and solutions that support water recycling in s sustainable energy efficient way. There are 270 people employed in the Sulzer Company based in Wexford.

This role requires the capabilities to design, develop, code, test and debug software of our embedded devices and systems. A key responsibility will be to recommend new approaches, advising on industry standards, and will work closely with hardware specialists and programming teams. We are looking for a/an Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer to join our FE_Products, Technology and Digitalization team in Ireland. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Technical responsibility for the design of our embedded software (firmware) for control, monitoring and connectivity solutions.

• Specify, design and document technical requirements, and define test plans as appropriate.

• Analyse and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of our designs.

• Work closely with internal and external resources to ensure work is completed to specification.

• Evaluate and select software components that will be used in larger solutions.

• Manage technical updates to our existing product portfolio.

• Advise on opportunities to streamline our control, monitoring and connected solutions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Honours Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or similar with 7+ years of experience in best practices software development, delivery, and deployment.

• In-depth knowledge of C programming languages.Experience in developing firmware for embedded applications.

• Knowledge of software architecture for connected industrial applications/solutions.

• Knowledge of embedded systems with IoT or M2M capability.

• Knowledge of industrial communications protocols (Modbus, CAN, OPC, DNP3,).

• Knowledge of Telecoms/Network communications protocols (TCP/IP, GPRS/3G/4G, Wireless, low energy protocols).

• Experience with version control software.

• Analytical skills for root cause determination.

• Experience of working in a multi-disciplinary and multinational team environment.

What we offer you

• Annual Leave - Enjoy 26 days of holiday.

• Pension - Benefit from a defined contribution pension scheme.

• Flextime - Work Life Balance

• Long Service Awards - We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.

• Employee Assistance Programme - Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.

• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities - Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.

• Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Project Engineer is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes coaching junior professionals and solving complex problems through investigation and analysis.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Key Responsibilities
Manage technical projects from initiation to completion.
Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets.
Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 5–7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong project management and engineering skills.
Proficiency in technical documentation and reporting.
Effective communication and leadership abilities.
Experience in cross-functional collaboration.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Winder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

A winder disassembles, repairs, rewinds, and reassembles electric motors, and generators. Pasadena, Texas

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

What we offer you

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

jobs.title: Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are hiring a Pump Mechanic full time, day shift. You will be responsible for repairing and maintaining Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Job Responsibilities:

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications:

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Pump repair experience preferred

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Head of HR - SEA Clusters
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The HR Director is responsible for leading HR strategy and operations for a business unit or function. This role supports organizational goals through effective talent management, workforce planning, and employee engagement.
This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3–5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1–3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business goals supporting 3 divisions across multiple countries in the region
- Lead talent acquisition, development, and retention efforts.
- Oversee payroll, compensation, benefits, and performance management.
- Lead labor cost budgeting process across multiple countries in the region.
- Partner with Legal Counsel to drive compliance culture.
- Ensure compliance with HR policies and labor laws.
- Partner with leadership to drive organizational effectiveness.
- Lead HR projects to improve in operational performance.
- Lead a team of HR professionals in the region.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Requires a minimum of 8 - 10 years of relevant working experience in a similar industry in managerial capacity.
- A degree in relevant field such as business management or Human Resources is preferred.
- Strong HR leadership and strategic planning experience.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Proven ability to lead HR teams and initiatives.
- Able to multi-task and detail oriented.

What we offer you

Fixed Transport Allowance, Bi-yearly heathy lifestyle incentive and enrichment allowance.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sachbearbeiter Ersatzteilvertrieb (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In dieser Position verantworten Sie die bundesweite Erstellung von Ersatzteilangeboten für die Segmente Kommunale Entwässerung sowie Haus- und Grundstücksentwässerung. Ihre Aufgaben

• Eigenständige technische und kaufmännische Bearbeitung von Anfragen und Bestellungen im Ersatzteilvertrieb

• Ermittlung von Lieferzeiten in SAP sowie in Abstimmung mit unseren Zulieferanten

• Kommunikation mit unseren internationalen Werken

• Versand von Stücklisten und Ersatzteildokumentationen an unsere Kunden

• Ausarbeitung und Erstellung von kommerziellen und technischen Angeboten

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung

• Erfahrung im technischen Ersatzteilvertrieb sowie im Kundendienst von Vorteil

• Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, auch in stressigen Situationen den Überblick zu behalten

• Teamfähigkeit und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen IT‑Systemen (z. B. SAP, Salesforce, MS Office)

• Englischkenntnisse im technischen Umfeld

What we offer you

• Internationale Zusammenarbeit, offene Unternehmenskultur und ein motiviertes Team

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Kostenloser Obstkorb, Kaffee und Wasser und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü

• Ein starkes, hilfsbereites Team mit gutem Zusammenhalt

• Moderne Arbeitsmittel

• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen, u. a.: Vergünstigungen/Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad ‑ Programm, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebliche Sonderleistungen wie Familienservice ‑ Hotline

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Centre Manager - Ipswich & Southampton

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del centro servizi - Ipswich e Southampton

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Ipswich and Southampton Service Centres. This is a pivotal, multi-site leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Southampton and Ipswich sites bring together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating machinery. Working with major global energy companies, utilities, and industrial operators, we’re focused on reliability, innovation, and customer success.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Own the P&L for both the Southampton and Ipswich Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.

• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.

• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.

• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.

• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams at both sites, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.

• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).

• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.

• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across multiple sites in an Industrial Engineering environment

• Experience in business management, P&L ownership, and aftermarket or service-based environments.

• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.

• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.

• LEAN/Continuous Improvement experience (desirable).

• NEBOSH qualification (desirable).

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution

• Private Medical Insurance

• Car / Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: SAP PS/SD Inhouse Consultant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As part of the SAP CoE the SAP PS/SD consultant is responsible for supporting the business by implementing Change Requests, being part of and SAP roll-outs and projects and supporting in the Incident and Problem Management on our SAP platforms. Key responsabilities:

• Manage activities related to the PS and SD modules

• Responsibility to make changes to SAP system configuration and to global master data in the PS & SD modules

• Responsible for providing on-going key user training

• Responsible for configuring and implementing localizations with the key users and consultants during rollouts

• Develop, configure, test and roll-out SAP PS & SD module settings based on the Sulzer template

• Provide detail functional specifications to assist technical team in the development of RICEF

You need to succeed:

• Strong SAP PS/SD expertise (project structures, budgeting, costing, pricing, sales order configuration).

• Basic ABAP debugging, Fiori (PS/SD) knowledge, and understanding of CS processes/customizing.

• Experience leading global teams and collaborating with senior management.

• 8–10 years experience in similar roles within multinational/matrix environments.

• Hands‑on SAP implementation experience (ECC; S/4HANA preferred).

• Engineering/IT degree; SD and ITIL certifications desirable.

• Strong analytical and customer‑focused approach, able to work under pressure; willingness to travel and work flexibly.

• Fluent English

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision. Pasadena, Texas

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required

• Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designs setups and methods where none exist

• Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to setup machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill

• Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision

• Working knowledge of tool geometry and application

• Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds

• 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

• Ability to work overtime as required

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.

Paid parental leave
Parental leave
Health insurance
401(k) matching
Paid time off
Vision insurance
Health savings account
Dental insurance
Gym membership
Employee assistance program
Disability insurance
401(k) 6% Match
Paid holidays
Wellness program

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Helper
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Helper role assist different shop departments ass needed. PHOENIX, ARIZONA

REPORTS TO:
Assigned Department Manager or designee ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Primary Functions:
o Have and maintain ability to use and operate forklifts
o Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures
o Be on the job site and in your assigned work area at the scheduled time
o Must be self-motivated and willing to learn
o Handle departments’ recycling and removing of all trash on a daily basis
o Assure all cables, shackles, straps and chains are put away daily
o Keep work area clean and well organized during all phases of the project
o Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, including all Supervisors, Managers, Leadmen and hourly personnel
o General cleanup of departments change room / restroom facilities
o Provide assistance to Core departments as required
o Must follow the STS dress code and maintain a professional appearance at all times
o Maintain LEAN objections within the department
o Perform specialized task as required
o Maintain accurate time sheets on a daily basis
o Complete company-required training programs

· Secondary Functions/
• Requirements:
o Steam clean and wash parts in the Wash Bay
o Transport equipment and parts around department and between departments
o Use PPE as identified in risk assessments or other related safety documents
o Do not undertake activities that have not been risk assessed, or where an assessment is not available or
understood
o Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager
o Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials
o Must be able to work overtime when necessary

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:
o High school diploma or equivalent

PHYSICAL DEMANDS
· While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
· Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
