jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Applications Engineer is responsible for evaluating customer requirements and developing technical and commercial proposals for industrial equipment solutions. This role serves as a critical link between customers, sales teams, and internal engineering/manufacturing to ensure accurate, timely, and competitive responses to inquiries.
This position operates in a fast-paced, high-volume environment supporting distributors, OEMs, EPCs, and end users across a wide range of applications. Applications include Pulp and Paper, Biofuels, Foods, Chemical processing, Mining / Metals, Industrial wastewater, and Auxiliary equipment in other segments as needed.
The Applications Group is a dynamic organization with both junior and senior engineers who possess a wide range of experience and competencies. This is a great opportunity to contribute to a growing company and offers great mentorship opportunities to enhance professional development.
This role is designed as a foundational position with clear visibility into commercial strategy and customer engagement, offering a defined pathway into Accounts Management and outside sales roles. This role is based out of our Easley, SC office.
Key Responsibilities:
Proposal & Technical Evaluation

• Review customer RFQs, specifications, and datasheets to determine appropriate product selection

• Perform pumping equipment sizing, selection, and configuration

• Generate detailed quotations including scope, pricing, and lead time
Customer & Sales Support

• Serve as a technical resource for internal sales teams and external customers

• Support distribution network with product selection, troubleshooting, and application guidance

• Participate in distributor and customer calls, visits, and training as needed

• Support sales efforts by contributing to technical sales strategy, participating in customer discussions, and developing an understanding of commercial drivers behind winning opportunities
Cross-Functional Coordination

• Work closely with the Project Management team to define documentation packages, testing requirements, and customer deliverables early in the quotation phase to ensure accurate scope, compliance, and execution readiness.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain to confirm feasibility, lead times, and cost

• Work with global teams when required to support international or specialized opportunities

• Ensure alignment between customer expectations and internal capabilities
Quote and Opportunity Management

• Manage multiple RFQs simultaneously in a high-volume environment

• Maintain accurate records of opportunities, quotes, and communications in Salesforce (CRM system)
Continuous Improvement & Team Support

• Identify opportunities to improve quoting efficiency, accuracy, and standardization

• Support development of tools, templates, and documentation

• Assist in training new team members and sharing application knowledge

Secondary Responsibilities:

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• None

Qualifications:

• Required
• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or related field.

• 0-5 years of related engineering experience (industrial, process, applications, pumps & hydraulics preferred)

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

• Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)

• Willingness to travel as needed

• Preferred
• Experience with pumps, fluid systems, or rotating equipment

• Exposure to reading specifications and technical drawings

• Familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce) and/or ERP systems (SAP)

• Experience working with distributors or in a customer-facing role

Key

jobs.title: Air Compressor Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Air Compressor Maintenance Technician is responsible for the installation, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of air compressors and related systems. This role ensures equipment operates safely, reliably, and efficiently while meeting company, customer, and regulatory standards. Responsibilities

• Install, maintain, inspect, and repair industrial air compressors and auxiliary equipment

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to minimize downtime

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues and recommend repairs

• Conduct routine inspections and performance testing of compressor systems

• Replace worn or defective parts, including motors, valves, seals, belts, and filters

• Read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and work orders

• Ensure compliance with safety policies, procedures, and industry regulations

• Document maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs accurately

• Support equipment upgrades, modifications, and system improvements

• Coordinate with operations, engineering, and management teams as needed

• Always maintain a clean and safe work environment

• Assist other trades and perform additional duties or work assignments as directed by the management team
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• High school diploma or GED required, technical certification or trade school preferred

• 3+ years of experience maintaining or repairing industrial air compressors or rotating equipment

• Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills

• Experience with reciprocating, centrifugal, or rotary screw compressors preferred

• Ability to read technical drawings and service manuals

• Familiarity with safety standards and lockout/tagout procedures

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• HVAC or refrigeration experience is a plus

• Must provide own personal tools

• Required to supply personal hand tools appropriate for the role

• Worked on following equipment, Quincy, Kaeser, Sullair.

Physical & Work Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs

• Ability to stand, bend, kneel, and work in industrial environments

• Willingness to work overtime, weekends, or on-call as required

• Ability to work in shop and field environments

Preferred Skills

• Experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or Power Generation industries

• Knowledge of vibration monitoring, alignment, and lubrication practices

• Strong attention to detail and safety awareness

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer ( Project Manager )
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Wexford is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer ( Project Manager ) that is product development focussed, giving you responsibility from concept through to prototype, testing, and successful product introduction.

You’ll help lead the next generation of submersible pumps and agitators, supporting our mission to deliver high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions for water recycling and sustainable operations worldwide.
About Sulzer Wexford
With over 250+ employees on site, Sulzer Wexford is a key engineering and manufacturing hub within Sulzer’s global network. The team’s work underpins critical water recycling, sustainability, and energy‑efficiency solutions used around the world.

What you’ll be doing

• Lead end‑to‑end product development projects using best‑practice project management methods.

• Design and develop new products, primarily submersible pumps and agitators — translating requirements into high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions.

• Oversee the build, test, and validation of prototypes, including detailed reporting, interpretation, and analysis of results.

• Support smooth introduction of new products into manufacturing and global markets.

• Act as the point of contact, collaborating with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure engineering, quality, and commercial alignment.

Who will succeed here?

• You will hold a formal qualification in Mechanical Engineering

• Someone able to translate requirements into practical, innovative product solutions

• A hands‑on problem solver with experience in testing, analysis, and validation

• A confident communicator comfortable working with diverse stakeholders

• Someone excited by the opportunity to influence the next generation of engineered products

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30

• 26 days annual leave

• A defined pension contribution

• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuous professional development

• Genuine opportunities for international mobility and long‑term progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Municipal Water
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We’re looking for a high-impact Key Account Manager to take ownership of one of our most significant long-term utility partnerships – a major regional water provider serving millions of customers across the East of England

This is a commercially critical role where you will own the account strategy end-to-end—driving growth across capital projects (pump packages and related equipment) and aftermarket services, while shaping the future of a well-established, high-value relationship. Your main responsibilities:

• Own the P&L and growth strategy for a utility account, with clear accountability for revenue and margin performance

• Drive the narrative with the customer—positioning us as a trusted, strategic partner across both capital investment and lifecycle services

• Lead and coordinate a multi-disciplinary account team, ensuring alignment across sales, service, engineering and delivery

• Build and deepen senior stakeholder relationships, influencing decision-making at operational and strategic levels

• Develop and execute a long-term account development plan, aligned to the customer’s AMP cycles and investment priorities

• Provide accurate forecasting, pipeline management and reporting

• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring continuous improvement and delivery excellence

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience in a Key Account Management or Strategic Account role within engineering, industrial or utilities environments

• Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets and driving growth

• Background in pumps, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems is highly desirable. Alternatively, direct experience working closely with a UK -based water utility provider is a strong advantage

• Demonstrated ability to build and manage high-value, long-term customer relationships

• Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams without direct line management

• Confident communicator, capable of engaging at both technical and executive levels

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into tangible commercial outcomes

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary

• Car or car allowance – EV options available

• Annual Bonus Scheme

• Private Medical cover

• 33 days annual leave

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Confidential Employee Assistance Programmes

• Wide range of retail and lifestyle discounts

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing

• Long Service Awards

• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Home working flexibility, with full diary management

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain.

This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid.

If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Any other European language is a plus

• Analytical and problema solving skills

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.

• Other fringe benefits

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: OTC Billing Accountant (French / Italian)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The OTC Billing Accountant supports end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash activities with a strong focus on collections, billing, cash forecasting, and credit management. The role works closely with Legal Entities, Sales, Project Management, and Finance stakeholders to optimize cash flow, manage credit risk, and drive process standardization across the Group.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Invoicing

• Prepare and issue accurate customer invoices based on contracts, service agreements, and purchase orders.

• Review and reconcile billing data, ensuring timely invoice dispatch in compliance with customer and regulatory requirements (e.g. B2B e‑invoicing).

• Collaborate with Sales, Project Management, Customer Service, and Collections teams to resolve billing queries.

• Support intercompany billing, month‑end and year‑end close activities, including billing‑related journal entries and reconciliations.

• Ensure compliance with OTC controls, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements. Supporting internal and external audits.

Collections & Cash forecasting

• Perform structured follow‑ups with customers (phone/email) to ensure timely payments in line with contractual terms. Driving overdue reduction across assigned Legal Entities through proactive management of customer collections.

• Identify, analyze, and resolve payment‑impacting disputes, coordinating with PMs, Sales, and Local Finance to ensure timely resolution.

• Monitor AR performance, maintain accurate records, and perform AR, revenue, and ageing analysis.

• Participate in stakeholder meetings, propose corrective actions, and escalate AR‑related risks when required.

• Support cash forecasting by providing reliable AR data and trends, payment expectations and accurate information in systems

Credit Management

• Perform customer credit risk assessments using external credit tools and reports and recommend and monitor customer credit limits in line with internal policies.

• Monitor credit exposure, ensure timely reporting, and escalating risks as needed. Close collaboration with Sales and Local Finance to support effective credit decisions.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Solid financial background with hands‑on experience in Order‑to‑Cash processes, such as Billing, Cash Collections, and/or Credit Management. Experience in a Finance or Shared Services environment is a strong advantage.

• Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or project‑based environments is preferred.

• Robust knowledge and experience in billing processes is a plus.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of French or Italian is a big plus.

• Strong understanding of the end‑to‑end Order‑to‑Cash cycle, including accounting principles, revenue recognition, and billing processes within Global Business Services or Finance Shared Services organizations.

• Highly proactive and ownership‑driven mindset: you anticipate issues, take initiative to resolve them, and follow through to completion without losing sight of priorities.

• Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills, with a structured, data‑driven and continuous‑improvement (Lean) approach to challenges.

• Strong focus on ownership of results: reliability in execution and delivery on commitments.

• Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills; success in this role requires continuous interaction with project teams, Sales, and Finance stakeholders, including the ability to influence and align across teams.

• Experience working with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, iScala or similar) is highly valued.

• Proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participat

jobs.title: Senior Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Under limited supervision, you will perform all necessary tasks in the repair and maintenance of Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. While following department policy and procedures manual. Job Responsibilities:

• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications

• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components

• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report

• Investigating and determining root cause failure

• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM

• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements

• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment

• Performing final testing and inspections

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of Pump or Rotating Machinery repair experience

• Extensive knowledge of and ability to use hand tools, precision measuring and testing equipment and machine shop equipment

• Analytical and interpersonal skills

• Attention to detail

• Ability to work with limited supervision

• Ability to travel to and work at customer sites

• Ability to work overtime as requested

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 5 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

jobs.title: Inside Sales Support (Aftermarket)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Inside Sales (Aftermarket) Support will be responsible for supporting FRC Wastewater treatment systems after they have been commissioned for operation. You will be responsible for proactively reaching out to customers to ensure they have a stock of spare parts. You will assist customers with ordering spare parts and answering questions about performance or technical issues.
Essential Functions: (80%)

• Call customers with FRC equipment to assist them with ordering spare parts.

• Assemble detailed project specific spare parts list, provide to Project Manager.

• Respond to customer questions regarding spare parts and upgrades.

• Function as entry point for questions from customers and sales representatives regarding technical and performance questions for installations provided by FRC.

• Follow up to confirm customer questions have been answered.

• When required, forward questions to the right person within organization and ensure adherence to FRC's 24-hour response philosophy.

• Maintain positive relationships with customers, FRC representatives, consultants, engineers and managers through responsive, effective and honest communications.

• Proactive communication with customers about the need for and functionality of spare parts, (Discontinued items, Upgrades, etc.)

• Contact vendors for specific project/non-standard part quotes.

• Generate Spare parts quotes for customers.

• Calculate the mark-up of the spare parts, based on the margin schedule.

• Create and Process sales Orders on Purchase orders received for Spare Parts.

• Organize / Process customer's order shipment details.

Secondary Functions: (20%)

• Capture and maintain detailed notes related to customer contacts, conversations about spares, warranty issues, and upgrades.

• Prepare a monthly report providing a structured overview of all documented notes and communications concerning spares, warranty matters, and system upgrades.

• Coordinate with QA/Logistics manager and Project Manager(s) to resolve warranty complaints.

Qualifications:

• 2-year technical diploma or degree

• or

• Minimum of 2 years of work experience in a related industrial field (mechanical/manufacturing)

• Preferable experience with shipping

Key Skills, Knowledge and Competencies:

• Proficient computer skills: Microsoft Office, knowledge of an inventory / bookkeeping program, and online freight management (i.e., UPS, FedEx).

• A strong customer focus is essential, working with both internal and external customers.

• Fluent English skills verbally and written.

• Mechanical aptitude.

• Preferable basic mechanical and/or electrical knowledge.

• Highly self-motivated

• Good organizational and time management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to listen and understand others.

• Team player with strong interpersonal skills with the ability to foster strong working relationships.

• Ability to work independently and follow through on work assignments with minimal direction.

• Detail oriented.

• Positive attitude towards change and growth

• Has cultural flexibility. Is capable to deal with the different corporate cultures and cultures of production plants of FRC's clients.

• Is allowed to legally work in the U.S.

Environmental, safety & health requirements:

• Complies with QESH policy

• Complies and participates with SBP (Safety Behavior Program)

• Performs its functions following and understanding the Job Safety Analysis (JSA), is aware of the workplace hazards

• Avoids and reports unsafe behaviors and unsafe conditions

• Uses and maintains personal protective equipment

• Reports accidents and near accidents

• Complies with environmental and safety rules, policies, work instructions, manuals, etc.

jobs.title: Millwright
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A professional who operates industrial machinery found in construction sites, factories, power plants, and other sectors. Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble compressors, turbines, gearboxes, expanders and other rotating equipment

• Assemble machines as per instructed by Supervisor

• Possess a sufficient quantity of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments

• Continuously upgrade knowledge of projects, materials and procedures to better perform duties including safety cards

• Report any instances of spillage, uncontrolled exposure or other related safety issues to their line manager.

• Ensure the correct use of waste segregation facilities and the efficient use of natural resources and raw materials.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• High School diploma or equivalent

• Valid driver’s License

• Ability to obtain a Transportation Workers Identification credentials(TWIC)

• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of the organization

• Strong mechanical aptitude and ability learn technical and design aspects for Rotating Equipment service and repairs

• Physical ability to work in a shop and field environments

• Travel is required

• Experienced in driven equipment repair such as generators, compressors, and pumps

• Experienced in alignments

• Professional presentation, in manner, attitude, appearance, speech, and dependability, to the customer at all times.

What we offer you

• 401K with 6% company match

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lead Sales Engineering
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Lead Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales team by providing technical guidance and ensuring that proposed solutions meet customer needs. This role also contributes to product development feedback and customer onboarding.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision.
• To plan and undertake regular customer visits, maximising enquiry generation and driving order intake to deliver the growth plan.

• Prepare, submit and follow up all enquiries to customers in a timely and professionally manner.

• Build and maintain long-term relationships with key customers.

• Act as the primary contact for all product lines

• Ability to evaluate market environment in terms of products, pricing, distribution network, and to develop new strategies and action plains in the target markets.

• To take responsibility for their contribution to the RFC for Order Intake for the customers/allocated territory that he/she is responsible for.

• Collaborate with technical and operations teams to ensure service projects meet Sulzer’s quality standards.

• Commercial acumen, customer service skill, Influencing and persuasion skill, general computer skill

• Ability to act independently

jobs.title: Winder/ Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Falkirk is a strategic investment site, built to be one of the most advanced rotating equipment service centres in the UK.

That investment is real — bigger machines, heavier lifts, and a 2 MW high‑voltage test bed that lets us fully load‑test motors and generators before they go back to site. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Dismantling, rewinding, rebuilding and testing AC and DC motors, including traction motors

• LV motor rewinds and full electro‑mechanical overhauls

• Strip, clean and prepare stators and armatures for rewinding

• Manufacture and fit coils to original design — random wound and formed coils

• Dip, bake and varnish windings using dip tanks or VPI where required

• Carry out static electrical tests and record results

• Basic mechanical fitting on associated equipment like pumps and gearboxes

What we’re looking for

• Time‑served Winder, Fitter or Electrical Machine Repair background

• Solid experience stripping, rewinding, assembling and testing AC/DC motors

• Comfortable in a mechanical / electrical workshop environment

• Can read drawings, follow procedures, and work methodically

• Takes pride in quality and doing the job right first time

• Formal qualifications help — hands‑on experience matters more.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities

• Preparation and submission of tenders in line with customer requirements, ensuring that tenders meet Sulzer commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the Delegation of Authority

• Work closely with Sales and Operations to provide cost effective, competitive solutions in line with Sulzer objectives

• Provide support to the Sales teams related to tendering activities

• Obtain the quotes from sub-vendors for Mechanical Seal / Motors / Instruments and other equipment / services.

• Responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst meeting Sulzer objectives

• Overall responsibility for sustaining the profit margin on tenders

• Follow up outstanding tenders with customers/sales agents in accordance with agreed Company requirements, and in conjunction with Sales teams and Conditions, TOA.

• Update tender status to Customer Eva in Salesforce after issuing the tender, supported by Sales

• Ensure application of Sulzer tools and compliance with policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines

• Work closely with the Sales teams to optimize tenders, and to support maximization of conversion of tenders to orders

• Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement

• Work together with Operations to ensure smooth and efficient handover of tenders/orders

• All other duties as relevant to the Tendering function

Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 2 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are required to carry out the role.
Relevant experience within related industry and products
Technical and commercial acumen.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple proposals.
Willingness to learn and adapt.
Knowledge of SAP or D365 or equivalent ERP

What we offer you

Career opportunities
Medical Benefit
Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic/Technician-Night Shift
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

A mechanic is a professional who repairs and maintains machinery and parts. A mechanic's duties include inspecting, diagnosing, and fixing faults, conducting safety checks, and keeping records of the work done. A mechanic uses manual tools and technological devices to perform the tasks. A mechanic also communicates with customers and coworkers to establish timeframe and cost of each project. Mechanic/Technician-Night Shift

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Assemble machines utilizing the specified assembly checklist

• Disassemble and inspect machines utilizing the specified disassembly and inspection checklist

• Complete all documentation pertaining to the work assignment

• Communicate mechanical issues found during inspection to the appropriate Department Supervisor

• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Mechanical personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments

• Must have experience working with turbo machinery repair

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks

What we offer you

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Clean Line Operatives
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

As a Process / Clean Line Operative, you’ll be responsible for preparing and cleaning turbine components to the highest standards, supporting the delivery of world-class engineering services. Job Responsibilities

• Clean and process turbine components using chemical tanks, grit blasting, vapour blasting, and hand cleaning.

• Operate specialist equipment such as ball burnishing machines.

• Maintain high standards of quality and safety in all tasks.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within the workshop.

• Follow all health, safety, and environmental procedures.

Job Qualifications

• A flexible, team-oriented approach with the ability to work independently.

• Ability to follow technical instructions and safe working practices.

• Previous experience in a cleanline or workshop environment is preferred, but full training will be provided.

What we offer you

• A competitive hourly rate

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst

titleByLocale.it: Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analista
titleByLocale.en: Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst
titleByLocale.fr: Inventaire des ventes et planification des opérations Analyste des activités

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Elevate your career with a newly created opportunity at Sulzer, as we build out a best-in-class Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) capability within our Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR) division. PPR focuses on servicing and enhancing critical rotating equipment across industries such as energy, water and manufacturing. Operating in a dynamic aftermarket environment means demand is less predictable and projects often involve bespoke or reverse engineering, making planning more complex — and far more interesting — than in a traditional manufacturing setting. As a Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst, you will help shape this capability from the ground up, driving data-led decision making across teams in the UK, Europe and Africa. You will connect multiple systems, improving visibility and enabling more aligned, forward-looking planning. Working across Salesforce, SAP, D365 and Qlik Sense, Tagetik and other systems you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support both operational and strategic decisions in a fast-moving, evolving environment.

What You will Be Doing

• Analyse demand trends using CRM data, partnering closely with Sales, Service and Tendering teams

• Combine internal performance data with external market insights to inform demand planning

• Assess supply-side data across multiple manufacturing entities, identifying risks and opportunities

• Design and maintain dashboards and reports that provide visibility across sales pipelines and operational plans

• Translate data into meaningful metrics and visualisations to improve forecasting and performance tracking

• Present insights and recommendations in monthly SiOP reviews, driving actions and continuous improvement

• Establish and improve data governance, consistency and best practices across systems

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Operations and Sales — aligning teams around a single version of the truth

What We are Looking For

• Proven experience (c.5+ years) in an analytical role, preferably in job-shop engineering, manufacturing or service environment (but not necessary).

• Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI and/or Qlik Sense), with the ability to build impactful dashboards

• Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (e.g. SAP, D365, Salesforce)

• Strong data modelling and Excel capability

• A curious, problem-solving mindset with the ability to spot trends and challenge assumptions

• Confident stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing across functions

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, less structured environment where you can shape processes, not just follow them

• Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region

What we offer you

• A fully remote home-based role with occasional travel across regions.

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Elevate la vostra carriera con un'opportunità appena creata a Sulzer, in quanto costruiamo una capacità di business Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) all'interno della nostra divisione Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). PPR si concentra sulla manutenzione e il miglioramento delle attrezzature rotanti critiche in settori come l'energia, l'acqua e la produzione. Operare in un ambiente di mercato dinamico significa che la domanda è meno prevedibile e i progetti spesso comportano l'ingegneria su misura o inversa, rendendo la pianificazione più complessa — e molto più interessante — che in un ambiente di produzione tradizionale. Come Analista commerciale di pianificazione dell'inventario e delle operazioni, vi aiuterà a plasmare questa capacità da zero, guidando il processo decisionale guidato dai dati tra le squadre nel Regno Unito, Europa e Africa. Connetterai più sistemi, migliorando la visibilità e consentendo una pianificazione più allineata e previsionale. Lavorando attraverso Salesforce, SAP, D365 e Qlik Sense, Tagetik e altri sistemi trasformerete i dati complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni che supportano le decisioni operative e strategiche in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Cosa farai
• Analizzare le tendenze della domanda utilizzando i dati CRM, collaborando strettamente con i team Sales, Service e Tendering
• Combina i dati delle prestazioni interne con informazioni sul mercato esterno per informare la pianificazione della domanda
• Valutare i dati sul lato dell'offerta in più entità di produzione, identificare rischi e opportunità
• Progettare e mantenere cruscotti e report che forniscono visibilità attraverso le pipeline di vendita e piani operativi
• Tradurre i dati in metriche e visualizzazioni significative per migliorare la previsione e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni
• Presenti approfondimenti e raccomandazioni nelle recensioni mensili di SiOP, azioni di guida e miglioramento continuo
• Stabilire e migliorare la governance dei dati, la coerenza e le migliori pratiche nei sistemi
• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con Finanza, Operazioni e Vendite – allineare le squadre intorno ad una singola versione della verità Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza comprovata (c.5+ anni) in un ruolo analitico, preferibilmente nell'ingegneria del negozio di lavoro, nell'ambiente di produzione o di servizio (ma non necessario).
• Forte esperienza con gli strumenti BI (Power BI e/o Qlik Sense), con la capacità di costruire cruscotti d'impatto
• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP/CRM (ad esempio SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte modellazione dei dati e capacità di Excel
• Una mentalità curiosa e risolutiva dei problemi con la capacità di individuare le tendenze e sfidare i presupposti
• Confident stakeholder management skills, con esperienza che influenza le funzioni
• Confortevole lavoro in un ambiente veloce e meno strutturato in cui è possibile modellare i processi, non solo seguirli
• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente attraverso la regione EMEA Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo a casa completamente remoto con viaggi occasionali in tutte le regioni.
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali
• Assicurazione medica privata
• 33 giorni di ferie annuali.
• Contributi pensionistici definiti.
• Accesso a Medicash che ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni, come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.
• Supporto confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping e l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.
• Noleggio auto personale scontato per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.
• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.
• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.

PPR focuses on servicing and enhancing critical rotating equipment across industries such as energy, water and manufacturing. Operating in a dynamic aftermarket environment means demand is less predictable and projects often involve bespoke or reverse engineering, making planning more complex — and far more interesting — than in a traditional manufacturing setting. As a Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst, you will help shape this capability from the ground up, driving data-led decision making across teams in the UK, Europe and Africa. You will connect multiple systems, improving visibility and enabling more aligned, forward-looking planning. Working across Salesforce, SAP, D365 and Qlik Sense, Tagetik and other systems you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support both operational and strategic decisions in a fast-moving, evolving environment. What You will Be Doing
• Analyse demand trends using CRM data, partnering closely with Sales, Service and Tendering teams
• Combine internal performance data with external market insights to inform demand planning
• Assess supply-side data across multiple manufacturing entities, identifying risks and opportunities
• Design and maintain dashboards and reports that provide visibility across sales pipelines and operational plans
• Translate data into meaningful metrics and visualisations to improve forecasting and performance tracking
• Present insights and recommendations in monthly SiOP reviews, driving actions and continuous improvement
• Establish and improve data governance, consistency and best practices across systems
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Operations and Sales — aligning teams around a single version of the truth What We are Looking For
• Proven experience (c.5+ years) in an analytical role, preferably in job-shop engineering, manufacturing or service environment (but not necessary).
• Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI and/or Qlik Sense), with the ability to build impactful dashboards
• Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (e.g. SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Strong data modelling and Excel capability
• A curious, problem-solving mindset with the ability to spot trends and challenge assumptions
• Confident stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing across functions
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, less structured environment where you can shape processes, not just follow them
• Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region What we offer you
• A fully remote home-based role with occasional travel across regions.
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Augmentez votre carrière grâce à une opportunité nouvellement créée chez Sulzer, alors que nous développons une capacité de vente, d'inventaire et de planification des opérations (SiOP) au sein de notre division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). La RPP met l'accent sur l'entretien et l'amélioration des équipements rotatifs essentiels dans les industries comme l'énergie, l'eau et la fabrication. L'exploitation dans un environnement dynamique de marché secondaire signifie que la demande est moins prévisible et que les projets impliquent souvent une ingénierie sur mesure ou inverse, rendant la planification plus complexe — et bien plus intéressante — que dans un contexte de fabrication traditionnel. En tant qu'analyste commercial de l'inventaire des ventes et de la planification des opérations, vous aiderez à façonner cette capacité à partir de la base, en conduisant la prise de décision axée sur les données à travers les équipes au Royaume-Uni, en Europe et en Afrique. Vous connecterez plusieurs systèmes, améliorant la visibilité et permettant une planification plus alignée et tournée vers l'avenir. En travaillant avec Salesforce, SAP, D365 et Qlik Sense, Tagetik et d'autres systèmes, vous transformerez des données complexes en informations claires et exploitables qui soutiennent les décisions opérationnelles et stratégiques dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Ce que vous ferez
• Analyser les tendances de la demande à l'aide de données CRM, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes Ventes, Service et Appel d'offres
• Combiner les données internes sur les performances et les perspectives du marché extérieur pour éclairer la planification de la demande
• Évaluer les données relatives à l'offre dans plusieurs entités manufacturières, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités
• Concevoir et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord et des rapports qui offrent une visibilité sur l'ensemble des pipelines de vente et des plans opérationnels
• Traduire les données en mesures et visualisations significatives pour améliorer les prévisions et le suivi des performances
• Présenter des points de vue et des recommandations dans les examens mensuels des PON, les actions de pilotage et l'amélioration continue
• Établir et améliorer la gouvernance des données, la cohérence et les meilleures pratiques entre les systèmes;
• Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle avec Finance, Opérations et Ventes – aligner les équipes autour d'une seule version de la vérité Ce que nous cherchons
• Expérience éprouvée (c.5+ années) dans un rôle d'analyse, de préférence dans l'ingénierie des ateliers, la fabrication ou l'environnement de service (mais pas nécessaire).
• Forte expérience avec les outils BI (Power BI et / ou Qlik Sense), avec la capacité de construire des tableaux de bord impactés
• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP/CRM (par exemple SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte capacité de modélisation des données et d'Excel
• Un état d'esprit curieux et résolvant les problèmes avec la capacité de repérer les tendances et de contester les hypothèses
• Compétences en gestion des parties prenantes avec une expérience influant sur l'ensemble des fonctions
• Travail confortable dans un environnement rapide et moins structuré où vous pouvez façonner les processus, pas seulement les suivre
• Volonté de voyager occasionnellement dans la région de l'EMEA Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un rôle entièrement isolé à domicile avec des déplacements occasionnels entre les régions.
• Un salaire de base compétitif
• Régime annuel de primes personnelles basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle
• Assurance médicale privée
• 33 jours de congé annuel.
• Cotisations définies.
• L'accès à Medicash vous aide à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.
• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.
• L'accès à des réductions sur le style de vie de divertissement shopping plus la possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.
• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.
• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.
• Des possibilités d'apprentissage continu grâce aux voies d'apprentissage Sulzer.
• En tant que titulaire du Prix Bronze du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la défense, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes volontaires dans des politiques d'entraînement, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne croissant. Sulzer

jobs.title: IT Lead Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s transformation journey as a lead IT Project Manager and play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact IT initiatives. You’ll have the opportunity to manage a diverse project portfolio, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to the modernization of our IT landscape by identifying opportunities for leveraging technology to drive business growth, improve processes and enhance productivity. This is a unique chance to drive meaningful change and develop your career in a dynamic, global environment.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

Portfolio & Project Management

• Lead and guide overall execution of multiple IT Projects , ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic priorities.

• Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure timely delivery , budget adherence and manage interdepen dencies between projects.

• Maintain project documentation, status reports, and dashboards for leadership and stakeholders.

Governance & Methodology

• Apply and promote consistent project management methodologies, tools, and reporting standards.

• Ensure compliance with governance frameworks and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Stakeholder Management

• Build strong relationships with business leaders and IT stakeholders to ensure project objectives meet business needs , leading the IT project Steering Committees.

• Act as a key point of contact for project-related communication and issue resolution .

• Proactively engage in business partnering, acting as a trusted advisor to business divisions and supporting the identification, prioritization, and management of IT demand s to maximize value delivery.

Demand Management

• Lead the demand management process by capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing business requirements, ensuring alignment with Sulzer’s strategic objectives and resource availability.

• Facilitate transparent decision-making on project selection and resource allocation.

Vendor & Financial Management

• Support vendor selection, contract management, and performance tracking for project-related services.

• Assist in project budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance tracking.

Operational Excellence

• Drive efficiency in project delivery and resource allocation.

• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across project processes and tools.

Sulzer Core Ambition Program

• Actively contribute to the SulzerCore Ambition Program by ensuring that all project and portfolio activities support the organizations goals and strategic ambitions.

Team Collaboration & Development

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to a culture of accountability and excellence.

• Mentor junior project managers or team members as needed.

• Drive efficiency across IT operations, including resource allocation, vendor management, and performance tracking.

• Champion continuous improvement and simplification across the IT landscape, including consolidation of tools and platforms.

OneSulzer Culture

• Promote and embody the OneSulzer mindset by fostering collaboration with an “ Entrepreneurial sp irit and teamwork ” , challenging the status quo, and supporting a unified, “Customer focus” culture across all divisions and teams.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• 9+ years of professional experience in IT and business/industry environments

• At least 5 years of experience in team management and leadership roles

• Strong experience with project methods and methodologies

• Solid knowledge of operating models (Ops Models)

• Proven

jobs.title: Shop Foreman
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As the Shop Foreman you will play a critical role in overseeing daily operations, ensuring efficient job execution, maintaining high standards of safety and quality, and fostering employee development. This position serves as a key liaison between the service center, customers, and internal teams such as Sales and Purchasing. You will directly supervise craftsmen and be responsible for driving performance, accountability, and continuous improvement. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Review work scopes and time estimates, ensuring efficient job execution

• Maintain direct customer contact and address needs

• Provide technical coaching and problem-solving support to craftsmen

• Ensure adherence to SEMS procedures, OEM, and customer specifications

• Manage resources, quality, and safety on the shop floor

• Conduct performance reviews and provide employee coaching

• Ensure craftsmen have necessary resources for safe and efficient work

• Support employees in setting and achieving performance and career development goals

• Coordinate on-the-job training, mentoring, and technical development opportunities

QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of Electro-Mechanical repair experience, pump industry preferred

• Strong leadership and communication skills

• Available for 10-hour workdays (Mon-Fri) with weekend on-call duties on a rotating basis

• Skilled in identifying nonconformance issues and driving corrective actions

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across Sales, Operations, and Support teams

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Strategic Accounts Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Strategic Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients. This role ensures that client needs are met, identifies new business opportunities, and coordinates with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions that drive long-term value.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Summary: Assigned accounts, with strategic importance to the company, specifically for the chemical process industry (CPI) and fertilizers segments in Western USA. Accounts may be local, national, international or have other important factors that classifies it as a strategic account. Also, promotes the sales and service of Sulzer products and accessories (new equipment & after-market: spare parts, repairs & field service) to established and new customers by providing technical and commercial proposals in response to inquiries, and interfacing between customers and company facilities, following written policies and procedures. Assigned territory and segments would be covered by a mix of direct accounts and distribution (indirect).

Essential Functions:
 Develops account strategy and account planning
 Reviews sales history and forecasts future business
 Evaluates competitor offerings
 Develops relationships based on trust and performance
 Works on regional and national agreements as required by Sales Management
 Finds and develops new customers within existing territories
 Negotiates orders including all technical, commercial, and legal details to the mutual satisfaction of customers and the Company
 Calls on prospective customers and maintains contracts with customers in relation to their requirements
 Secures and renews orders, arranges delivery dates and other peripherals integral to selling
 Travels to customer locations to insure close and regular face-to-face contacts.
 Safety obligations:
* All employees follow current Sulzer safety programs.
* All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.
 All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:
 Performs other duties as assigned.
 Provides sales support to distributors and end users as needed.
 Provides application and technical support to distributors and end-users, as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
 None

Qualifications:
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, marketing, or other technical related experience
 Thorough knowledge of Sulzer products and services as well as competitor’s products and services
 Experience in appropriate market segments
 In-dept knowledge of sales and marketing techniques
 Knowledge of Microsoft office products
 Good written and verbal communication skills

Physical Requirements:
 Lifting up to 25 pounds

This job description is not an employment agreement or contract. Management has the exclusive right to alter this job description at any time without notice.

THIS COMPANY ENDORSES THE CONCEPT OF EMPLOYMENT-AT-WILL. THIS MEANS THAT YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO RESIGN AT ANY TIME FOR ANY REASON, AND THE COMPANY MAY SEVER THE EMPLOYMENT RELATIONSHIP AT ANY TIME FOR ANY REASON.

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefit

jobs.title: QC Inspector
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a QC Inspector to join our GT Aero team in Aberdeen.

Are you detail-focused and passionate about engineering quality? Join our expert GT Aero team in Aberdeen, where you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring the integrity and compliance of our gas turbine overhaul and inspection operations. Be part of a company committed to technical excellence and sustainability within the energy transition. Job Responsibilities:

• Perform bulk and detail strip inspections of gas turbines and provide comprehensive defect reports

• Carry out stage inspections during engine builds to ensure compliance with quality standards

• Maintain and control workshop Control Order Files and associated documentation

• Ensure all measuring equipment is calibrated, certified, and aligned with Quality Management System requirements

• Assist with shipping and receipt of materials to and from approved vendors, expediting sub-con activities efficiently

Job Qualifications:

• Previous experience in a similar inspection or mechanical quality role, ideally within a gas turbine environment

• Proven ability to understand and interpret engineering drawings and illustrated parts catalogues

• Working knowledge of industrial or power gas turbines and associated components

• A minimum of NC in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; HNC is preferred (or suitable proven experience in lieu of formal qualifications)

• Strong organisational skills and ability to work collaboratively with workshop and quality teams

What we offer you

• Enjoy a better work-life balance with our 9-day fortnight, giving you a three-day weekend every other week

• Competitive base salary

• Inclusion in a company-wide bonus program

• Attractive overtime pay scheme

• 33 days of annual leave

• Private medical insurance

• On-site parking

• Access to various discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle

• An Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support services, including counselling and resources to help manage personal and work-related issues, enhancing overall well-being and productivity

• Continuous learning and development opportunities through on-the-job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways, our dedicated online platform for professional growth

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Analista de Engenharia JR
Gas Turbine Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we specialize in the repair, overhaul, and field service of industrial, marine, and power gas turbines. With over two decades of expertise, our team delivers tailored solutions to clients worldwide, ensuring reliability, performance, and rapid turnaround. From spare parts and consultancy to full turbine refurbishment, we’re the trusted partner for critical rotating equipment.

This role is based at our Netherley facility near Stonehaven in Aberdeenshire, a key hub for our turbine operations and customer support.

Your Role:

As a Fitter, you’ll be responsible for the hands-on repair and overhaul of gas turbines, power turbines, and associated equipment. You’ll work as part of a skilled workshop team, ensuring high standards of engineering, safety, and documentation throughout the build process. Job Responsibilities

• Strip, inspect, sub-assemble, and rebuild turbine components.

• Accurately record critical measurements and report non-conformances.

• Maintain clean and organised workstations, ensuring tooling and chemicals are stored correctly.

• Complete all build documentation and submit for review.

• Support apprentice training and contribute to a culture of safety and quality.

• Input working hours into company systems and assist with non-conformance reporting

Job Qualifications

• Previous experience in a similar workshop or engineering role.

• Knowledge of gas turbine repair and refurbishment (advantageous).

• Experience in fabrication, repair, or construction environments.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Good communication and organisational skills.

• A team-oriented, adaptable approach.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• 9-day fortnight working pattern (every other Friday off)

• Annual performance-based bonus

• Private medical insurance

• 33 days of annual leave

• Access to retail and entertainment discounts — including Costco membership

• Discounted personal car leasing for employees, family, and friends

• Confidential support via our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The role is responsible for managing technical projects or processes independently with limited supervision. The role includes solving complex problems through investigation and analysis, and managing projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Job Responsibilities

• Manage technical projects from initiation to completion on time.

• Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets.

• Project cost monitor and control, and money collection follow up.

• Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies.

• Ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Typically a University degree, majored in mechanical, engineering, or business management.

• At least of 5–7 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Being familiar with motors or pumps is an advantage.

• Strong project management and engineering skills.

• Good English skills.

• Effective communication and leadership abilities.

• Experience in cross-functional collaboration.

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB söker industrisäljare för våra
kunder i Stockholmsområdet/Mälardalen, Sverige Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB söker industrisäljare för våra
kunder i Stockholmsområdet/Mälardalen, Sverige

Arbetsbeskrivning:

• Kund och budgetansvar för våra kunder inom bland annat Papper & Massa,
Gruv & Metall samt Energisektorn i Stockholmsområdet och Mälardalen.

• Utveckla relationer med nya och existerande kunder samt partners
på alla nivåer och i alla relevanta funktioner

• Planera och boka kundbesök, antalet resdagar kommer att var 2-3 per vecka

• Teknisk assistans för produkt och processproblem, produktutbildning

• Göra produktval och offerter på kundförfrågningar

• Bearbeta eftermarknaden hos dina kunder för ökad reservdels och
service försäljning

• Förhandla projekt- och kontraktsvillkor som tillgodoser både kund och företag

• Planera och stödja marknadsaktiviteter vid tex. mässor och andra events

• CRM-rapportera aktiviteter och underhålla kunddatabasen

Kvalifikationer:

Du har väl utvecklad teknisk förståelse och kommersiella egenskaper. Dokumenterad försäljningserfarenhet till industrikunder där papper & massaindustrin, gruv & metall och energisektorn är viktiga i regionen.

Du är en stark kommunikatör och har lätt att skapa relationer på alla nivåer.
Vi söker en öppen, analytisk person med fallenhet för affärer. Du pratar svenska och engelska flytande och du har B-körkort.

Relevant bakgrund för denna tjänst innefattar arbete från processindustri, helst från massa- eller pappersindustrin.

Vi ser gärna att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning, helst inom teknik eller kemi. Du kan föra tekniska resonemang, håller gärna presentationer samtidigt som du tycker om att ge praktisk service.

Vi erbjuder ansvar för Sulzers industrikunder i Stockholmsområdet/Mälardalen. Du blir en del av vårt säljteam mot industrin med stöd från offert-, order- och serviceavdelningar.

Du kommer att sitta placerad på lämplig ort i din säljregion.

Frågor om tjänsten kan ställas till Ola Persson, Head of Industry Sales Sweden.
Telefon 070-5187910 eller ola.persson@sulzer.com

Urvalet sker löpande, välkommen med din ansökan.

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
