jobs.title: Spares & Repairs Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer GT Aero, we are a recognised global leader in the maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) of aero‑derivative gas turbines. Our Netherley, Aberdeenshire facility is a centre of excellence, supporting customers worldwide with innovative, responsive and reliable solutions that keep critical equipment running. With continued investment and growth across the business, this is an exciting opportunity to join a high‑performing team and play a key role in supporting our spares and repairs operations.

We are looking for a Spares & Repairs Coordinator to support the effective handling of customer requests for spare parts and component repairs. In this role, you will work closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams to ensure enquiries are processed efficiently, quotations are prepared accurately, and orders are progressed smoothly from initial enquiry through to completion. You will be a vital part of the end‑to‑end process, helping deliver the high standards of service that Sulzer is known for globally. What you’ll be doing:

• Act as a first point of contact for customer spares and repairs enquiries, responding promptly and professionally

• Support the review of customer requirements with internal teams and external suppliers to confirm feasibility, lead times and costs

• Prepare accurate quotations for spares and repairs and issue them to customers in line with internal processes

• Coordinate orders from receipt through to completion, liaising with internal departments, suppliers and customers throughout

• Provide regular updates to customers, ensuring orders and repair activities are tracked and delivered on time

• Maintain accurate records within ERP and CRM systems, supporting reporting on order status, lead times and performance

• Assist with sales and tender activities where required, including preparing supporting information for spares and repairs opportunities

What you bring:

• Experience in a spares, repairs, aftermarket, coordination or customer support role within an engineering or industrial environment

• Experience using ERP and CRM systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce experience is desirable)

• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively

• Good communication skills, confident working with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• Commercial awareness with an understanding of quotations, pricing and cost control

• A proactive, detail‑focused and solutions‑driven approach, with the ability to perform well in a fast‑paced environment

What we offer you

Joining Sulzer GT Aero means becoming part of a business with a strong reputation in the gas turbine sector, a clear growth strategy and a collaborative working culture. In return, we offer:

• Competitive base salary with participation in the company‑wide bonus programme

• 33 days’ annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays)

• Free on‑site parking

• Access to discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment and lifestyle services

• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme

• Ongoing learning and development opportunities through on‑the‑job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Equipment Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Equipment Service Technician provides first level customer support for rental units deployed in the field. You will test, diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and debug electro-mechanical processing equipment and related systems. You must be able to communication and to work closely with Engineering, Project Management, and other Field Technicians on complex problems and assume responsibilities for continued customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites to assist with installation, start-up, servicing/repairing Wastewater Treatment Equipment (WWTE) and related sub-systems, and Operator training.
Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Assist the Service Technician at FRC2 with the refurbishment of rental units.

• Able and willing to travel 50% to 60% of the time to perform service-related tasks at customer sites.

• Troubleshoot a variety of Industrial WWTE and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues.

• Assist customers on the phone and/or in the field with troubleshooting equipment.

• Prepare detailed reports related to site visits, equipment problems/concerns/recommendations.

• Adhere to safety policies and use of safety equipment.

• Adhere to Corporate credit card and travel procedures.

• Position requires the ability to work extensive hours outdoors in sometimes less than ideal situations (adverse weather, noise, and possibly wet conditions)

• Physical Demand – Move and/or lift up to 50lbs, constant movement – standing, climbing, and walking.

• FRC is a Drug-Free Workplace, Employment subject to passing a drug test.

Education

• 2 years of technical trade or equivalent experience.

• Course work or prior verifiable work experience with installing, troubleshooting and/or repairing electrical/pneumatic/automated/industrial equipment.

• Must have mechanical aptitude with ability to use various hand/power tools to install/maintain equipment.

• Knowledge of electrical components and understanding of electrical current flow with ability to identify and troubleshoot the same.

Requirements:

• Able and willing to travel a minimum 50% - 60% of the time.

• Able and willing to learn and apply required customer service skills.

• Able to learn, produce, and submit accurate service and expense reports in a timely manner.

• Prefer experience in mechanical and electrical repair on industrial wastewater equipment.

• Prefer knowledge of automated machine controls.

• Able to read and follow blueprints, machine drawings, and electrical drawings.

• Proficient in the use of a laptop computer and Microsoft Office suite.

• Able to use a variety of common power and hand tools.

• Able to work safely and efficiently according to industry standards.

• Valid driver’s license.

• Strong troubleshooting ability – The ability to look at the overall picture and determine source of problem/issue.

• Ability to qualify for a US passport.

Working Conditions

• Requires about 50% - 60% travel and may include non-traditional work hours.

• Ready and willing to assist the service technician at the FRC 2 facility when not travelling.

• Industrial Wastewater Treatment facility which can be cold or hot and damp environment.

• Use of personal protection devices (ear plugs, hard hat, and eye protection).

• When not traveling, work may need to be completed from hotels, and/or office.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are

About the role The Equipment Service Technician provides first level customer support for rental units deployed in the field. You will test, diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and debug electro-mechanical processing equipment and related systems. You must be able to communication and to work closely with Engineering, Project Management, and other Field Technicians on complex problems and assume responsibilities for continued customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites to assist with installation, start-up, servicing/repairing Wastewater Treatment Equipment (WWTE) and related sub-systems, and Operator training. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
• Assist the Service Technician at FRC2 with the refurbishment of rental units.
• Able and willing to travel 50% to 60% of the time to perform service-related tasks at customer sites.
• Troubleshoot a variety of Industrial WWTE and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues.
• Assist customers on the phone and/or in the field with troubleshooting equipment.
• Prepare detailed reports related to site visits, equipment problems/concerns/recommendations.
• Adhere to safety policies and use of safety equipment.
• Adhere to Corporate credit card and travel procedures.
• Position requires the ability to work extensive hours outdoors in sometimes less than ideal situations (adverse weather, noise, and possibly wet conditions)
• Physical Demand – Move and/or lift up to 50lbs, constant movement – standing, climbing, and walking.
• FRC is a Drug-Free Workplace, Employment subject to passing a drug test. Education
• 2 years of technical trade or equivalent experience.
• Course work or prior verifiable work experience with installing, troubleshooting and/or repairing electrical/pneumatic/automated/industrial equipment.
• Must have mechanical aptitude with ability to use various hand/power tools to install/maintain equipment.
• Knowledge of electrical components and understanding of electrical current flow with ability to identify and troubleshoot the same. Requirements:
• Able and willing to travel a minimum 50% - 60% of the time.
• Able and willing to learn and apply required customer service skills.
• Able to learn, produce, and submit accurate service and expense reports in a timely manner.
• Prefer experience in mechanical and electrical repair on industrial wastewater equipment.
• Prefer knowledge of automated machine controls.
• Able to read and follow blueprints, machine drawings, and electrical drawings.
• Proficient in the use of a laptop computer and Microsoft Office suite.
• Able to use a variety of common power and hand tools.
• Able to work safely and efficiently according to industry standards.
• Valid driver’s license.
• Strong troubleshooting ability – The ability to look at the overall picture and determine source of problem/issue.
• Ability to qualify for a US passport. Working Conditions
• Requires about 50% - 60% travel and may include non-traditional work hours.
• Ready and willing to assist the service technician at the FRC 2 facility when not travelling.
• Industrial Wastewater Treatment facility which can be cold or hot and damp environment.
• Use of personal protection devices (ear plugs, hard hat, and eye protection).
• When not traveling, work may need to be completed from hotels, and/or office. What we offer you

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Technician is responsible for fabricating, installing, calibrating, testing, and repairing mechanical equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in the installation and repair of mechanical systems.
Calibrate and test mechanical equipment.
Fabricate and assemble mechanical components.
Follow maintenance schedules and safety protocols.
Document work performed and report issues.
Skills & Qualifications
May require basic vocational training (or equivalent work experience) and the ability to carry out assigned tasks after initial instruction or demonstration.

Mechanical aptitude and hands-on skills.
Ability to read technical diagrams.
Attention to detail and safety.
Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical and electromechanical systems.
Conduct research and testing to validate designs.
Collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams.
Ensure compliance with technical standards.
Document and present engineering findings.
Skills & Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Proficiency in mechanical design and simulation tools.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Eagerness to develop technical expertise.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: (Field) Service Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Proporcionar diagnóstico, asistencia técnica, entrenamiento y servicios de mantenimiento para bombas y equipos relacionados en las instalaciones del cliente.
El candidato puede estar basado en Lima o Arequipa. Funciones básicas

• Realizar la instalación, puesta en marcha y arranque de bombas y equipos asociados en las instalaciones del cliente.

• Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y las inspecciones de las bombas para garantizar un desempeño y una fiabilidad óptimos.

• Diagnosticar y solucionar problemas mecánicos, eléctricos y del sistema de control con bombas y componentes relacionados.

• Utilizar documentación técnica, esquemas y herramientas de diagnóstico para identificar y resolver problemas de forma eficaz.

• Coordinarse con los clientes para programar visitas de servicio, comunicar actualizaciones de proyectos y abordar cualquier duda o pregunta.

• Proporcionar formación y asistencia in situ a los clientes sobre el funcionamiento correcto y los procedimientos de mantenimiento de las bombas.

• Colaborar con los equipos internos para escalar y resolver problemas técnicos complejos según sea necesario.

• Documentar las actividades de servicio, incluidas las tareas de mantenimiento, el uso de piezas y las interacciones con los clientes, de forma clara y organizada.

• Cumplir los protocolos de seguridad y las políticas de la empresa mientras se trabaja en las instalaciones del cliente.

• Actuar como enlace entre los clientes y la empresa para garantizar un alto nivel de satisfacción del cliente.

• Proveer de entrenamiento a los clientes en el mantenimiento y operación de las bombas

• Documentar oportunidades de desarrollo de servicios dentro de las cuentas clave de la compañía

Condiciones de trabajo

• Este puesto requiere viajar con frecuencia a las instalaciones de los clientes, lo que puede implicar la exposición a diversas condiciones ambientales y exigencias físicas.

• Los ingenieros de servicio de campo pueden tener que trabajar en horarios flexibles, incluidas noches y fines de semana, para adaptarse a los horarios de los clientes y a las solicitudes de servicio urgentes

Requisitos

• Licenciatura o experiencia equivalente en ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería electromecánica, ingeniería eléctrica o un campo relacionado.

• Inglés intermedio o avanzado, requerido.

• Experiencia demostrada trabajando con bombas, preferiblemente en un servicio de campo o mantenimiento.

• Conocimientos sólidos de principios mecánicos, dinámica de fluidos y sistemas eléctricos.

• Dominio de la localización y reparación de averías en equipos mecánicos y eléctricos.

• Excelentes dotes de comunicación, tanto verbal como escrita, con capacidad para interactuar profesionalmente con clientes y compañeros.

• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y gestionar el tiempo eficazmente a fin de cumplir los plazos de servicio.

• Disponibilidad para viajar a las instalaciones de los clientes cuando sea necesario, a veces con poca antelación.

• Permiso de conducir válido y un historial de conducción limpio.

• Fuerte compromiso con la seguridad y cumplimiento de las directrices de seguridad.

• Se valorarán las certificaciones en mantenimiento de bombas o campos técnicos pertinentes.

• La e xperiencia con clientes mineros de la Zona Sur de Perú es un plus.

• Aptitud del Anexo 16 y Anexo 16A .

• Tener una certificación PMI o conocimiento probado en gestión de proyectos es un plus

What we offer you

Annual bonus
Health Insurance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerla

jobs.title: Principal Structure Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Expert is responsible for leading the design, development, and optimization of mechanical systems and components. This role provides expert-level technical leadership in mechanical engineering, ensuring that products meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. The expert collaborates across departments to drive innovation and resolve complex engineering challenges.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

This position is part of the Engineering department.
As a Structural Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Structural Engineer reports to Engineering Manager.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Design and 3D modeling of main metal structures of skids.

• Calculation of main metal structures of skids

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Civil Structure Engineering

• 8 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Master Planner
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Planner is responsible for scheduling and coordinating production activities to ensure timely delivery of products. This role works closely with procurement, manufacturing, and logistics to align production plans with demand forecasts and resource availability.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsivities:

• Develop and maintain master production schedules based on sales targets, customer orders, and forecast demand.

• Analyze manufacturing capacity, workload, and resource utilization(labor, equipment) to identify constraints and bottlenecks.

• Collaborate with production, engineering and procurement teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and implement corrective actions.

• Monitor master schedule progress and adjust plans proactively to achieve sales target.

• Maintain accurate planning data, documentation, and generate regular performance reports(e.g., schedule adherence, capacity utilization).

• Continuously improve scheduling processes to increase efficiency, reduce lead times, and support lean manufacturing initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications:
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least of 3-4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.
Strong analytical and organizational skills. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Knowledge of master planning and scheduling. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities.

What we offer you

target bonus: 16.67% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sr.Manager- Integration Developer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Group IT Engineering Specialist is responsible for developing and maintaining software and cloud-based applications, ensuring performance, security, and scalability. This role supports project delivery and contributes to technical innovation. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.

Purpose of the Job (summarized)
To ensure the continued development and support of Application Integration portfolio within the business organisation.

Ensuring that the business is kept at an efficient, functioning state regarding its integrated applications applications / processes.

We need Integration Developer in our Sales Tools team, reporting to the AGM Sales Tools, Global Delivery Center within the Global IT Team. We are looking for a self-driven.

Integration Developer

Your job

General Tasks:

• Develop and maintain Application Integration solutions (real-time / batch)

• Supporting and maintaining integration solutions and related components e.g. databases, queues

• Designing and modelling of databases, tables, stored procedures according to solution requirement

• Create / configure / fine tune / monitoring queues (MSMQ, Azure Service Bus queue, ActiveMQ)

• Scheduling and deployment

• Coordinate with different teams for fixing integration issues / new implementations

• Talend monitoring

• Monitoring, fixing non-working and broken jobs

• Monitoring the health of Talend remote engine / run-time servers. Give suggestions accordingly.

• Talend infrastructure; keeping Talend infrastructure up to date according to predefined schedule

• Patching, upgrades, deployment, etc.

• Debugging and optimizing implementations

Technical:

• Experience with (a) modern integration platform(s).

• Should be well-versed with SQL (database designing, create tables, stored procedures)

• Hands-on experience with creating / configuring / maintaining ActiveMQ / MSMQ / Azure Service Bus queue

• Developing APIs / web services in Talend

• Knowledge on FTP / SFTP / APIs / WEB services

• Sound knowledge of JSON / XML

• Knowledge of java scripts

• Experience on integration with SAP / Salesforce / MS Dynamics CRM

• Experience with Talend Cloud Real-Time Big Data Platform

• Nice to have – Talend certification; experience with Talend infrastructure, e.g. installation/upgrade of remote engines / runtimes will be an added advantage

Experience required in/with:

• Essential – willingness to expand their knowledge of the above

• A globally acting company and working in international project teams

• ~ 10 years overall experience in similar role out of which ~ 6-7 years in Talend

• Integration around Salesforce and SAP

• Salesforce platform events

• Talend data mapper

Education/Qualification:
o Any graduate with the above-mentioned professional experience

We offer
In an international environment, you will take over global responsibilities. You will work in an international team and in different cultures. This position enables to further personal development. If you can identify yourself with this challenge, then we would like to get to know you!

Location: Global Delivery Center located in Mumbai

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.title: Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnose, repair, and maintain ignition systems including control panels, coils, pickups, and wiring harnesses.
- Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot instrumentation such as pressure, temperature, and speed sensors.
- Perform functional testing and system validation to ensure proper engine performance and compliance with specifications.
- Interpret wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and technical manuals to support troubleshooting and installation activities.
- Conduct preventive maintenance and inspections on engines, compressors, and related equipment.
- Assist with engine startups, shutdowns, and commissioning activities.
- Identify root causes of system failures and implement corrective actions.
- Maintain accurate service records, calibration reports, and documentation.
- Ensure adherence to safety standards, company policies, and industry regulations.
- Collaborate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to optimize equipment reliability.

Required Qualifications:
- High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or associate degree in instrumentation, electrical, or mechanical discipline preferred.
- Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including engines and rotating equipment.
- Working knowledge of electrical systems (AC/DC), sensors, and control circuits.
- Ability to read and interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
- Proficiency with diagnostic tools, multimeters, and calibration equipment.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to job sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with natural gas engines and compressor packages.
- Familiarity with control systems (PLC/SCADA) and engine management systems.
- OEM training or certifications related to ignition or instrumentation systems.
- Knowledge of hazardous area classifications and safe work practices.

Physical Requirements:
- Ability to work in industrial environments, including exposure to noise, heat, and outdoor conditions.
- Capable of lifting up to 50 lbs and performing physically demanding tasks.
- Ability to climb ladders, work at heights, and in confined spaces.

Work Environment:
- Field-based role with travel to customer sites, including remote locations.
- May require on-call availability and extended work hours during outages or critical operations.

Key Competencies:
- Mechanical aptitude with cross-functional electrical/instrumentation skills
- Attention to detail and safety awareness
- Strong communication and teamwork
- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.

Maintain a clean and safe work area.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist – Turbine Repair Shop

titleByLocale.it: Macchinista manuale – Officina di riparazione turbine

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards. Heading & responsible for complete service center repairs activities, implementation of Lean principle & develop the service center with required Improvising in existing process

Main accountabilities and tasks

• Monitor, Manage, Control & solutions giving for all repairs pumps & Turbo equipment received for the repairs and overhaul at Vadodara service center.

• Leading & administer the service center team of around 20 guys with their day today work, follow-ups and guidance.

• Develop the existing service center with adopting good industrial practices & growing service center to excellence working on digitalization

• RFC Planning, Sales Commitment on Monthly, quarterly & Yearly basis. with dispatches by On time accuracy level and minimize the order cycle time by implementing best practices in place.

• Responsible for growth of repair business, quality and faster repair works, resulting in customer satisfaction.

• Interdepartmental coordination among Tendering team, procurement, Engineering & Sales functions for relevant subjective matters.

• Regular Meetings with concerns interdepartmental for timely Order intake and sales planning.

• Main KPI - Monthly RFC sales, Ontime delivery & Order Cycle time, & Safety walks & safety observations Monthly targeted

• Responsible for closing the cases of Warranty cases, profit margin assurance, Cash Collections & business growth.

• Interactions & managing for administrative work if any for service providing like MGCL, GPCB, Rental agreement, Nonconformance & service center legal documentation.

• Responsible for service center external audit for ISO standards

Work experience :

• 20+ Years experience in repairs of rotary equipment like High energy Pumps/ centrifugal compressor/ turbines rotors repairs & other equipment's.

• Capable of solution providing for complex equipment's repairs & reassembly of OEM & OEM- X pumps and turbo services. Versed with Dynamic balancing of Rotors, Rotors refurbishments, Retrofits

• Preparing SOP/ Work instructions for any new repairs equipment

• Handled approx. 20 guys team including quality, engineering, parts processing, operations and logistics

Languages known & good Communication skills
English, Hindi & Gujarati

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineering Specialist - Treatment Solutions
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Er du opptatt av en bærekraftig fremtid og levende fjorder? Vil du lære og utvikle deg hver eneste dag på jobb? Motiveres du av å ha en salgsjobb som bidrar til renere vann og et bedre miljø?

Som oss vet du at vann ikke bare er en ressurs – det er selve grunnlaget for alt liv. Og få ting gir større mening enn å jobbe med løsninger som sikrer at vannet renses, transporteres og forvaltes på best mulig måte.

Du ikke bare forstår prosessene – du elsker dem. Enten det handler om flotasjon, mekanisk filtrering eller biologisk rensing, så er du hjemme. Du har gjerne vært tett på anlegg og prosesser tidligere i karrieren, og du vet hva som faktisk fungerer i praksis – ikke bare på papiret.

Men du er ikke bare teknisk dyktig. Du er en relasjonsbygger som kundene raskt får tillit til, og du stiller alltid opp når de trenger deg. Salg gir deg energi – ikke fordi du selger, men fordi du løser problemer og skaper verdi for kunder som stoler på din faglige tyngde. Du trives i møte med mennesker, og du har et engasjement som smitter når du presenterer eller holder foredrag.

Du er god på å legge planer, liker å kombinere selvstendighet med samarbeid, og mestrer digitale verktøy som en naturlig del av hverdagen. En hverdag som innebærer noe reising for å besøke kunder – nye som gamle – er noe du setter pris på.
Høres dette ut som deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg.

Oppsummert håper vi at du er:

• En som har erfaring med B2B-salg og som blir motivert av lykkelig kunder

• Opptatt av å bygge tillit og være tilgjengelig for kundene

• Fleksibel og liker å styre hverdagen din selv

• Selvstendig og reiseglad

• Smart, engasjert og god på å løse problemer

• Strukturert og tydelig i kommunikasjonsformen – norsk er arbeidsspråket

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Hos Sulzer tror vi på kontinuerlig læring og mulighetene det skaper for fremtiden din. Vi jobber i team for å komme frem til de beste løsningene for våre kunder, og du vil ha ingeniører og fageksperter i ryggen som hjelper deg der det trengs.

I Norge har Sulzer kontorer og verksteder i Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Trondheim.

Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Du får firmabil, og det er ønskelig at du velger en miljøvennlig bil, på den måten bidrar du til å gjøre bedriften mer bærekraftig.

Denne stillingen er svært sentral for selskapet vårt, så er vi mest opptatt av å finne det riktige mennesket, som vil trives og ønsker å vokse sammen med oss. Nøyaktig hvor du bor, er ikke så viktig.

Søknadsfristen er søndag 14. juni , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende!

What we offer you

Vi har svært gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Det er tilgang til treningsrom i Fredrikstad og Asker.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Repair Center Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Repair Center Coordinator is responsible for supporting equipment repair project planning, execution, and monitoring. The role involves working independently with general supervision and contributing to project success through technical and analytical support. Key Responsibilities

• Assist in developing project plans, schedules, and estimates.

• Monitor project progress and report on milestones.

• Provide technical and analytical support to project teams.

• Ensure adherence to quality and safety standards.

• Liaise with users to gather and document requirements.

• Support vendor coordination and deliverable tracking.

Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Solid understanding of project management principles.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Effective communication and teamwork.

• Familiarity with project planning tools.

• Ability to work independently with general supervision.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

This role leads the Field Service & Engineering organization with full responsibility for the planning, execution, and documentation of field jobs, services, and projects. The position ensures delivery in line with defined scope, timelines, and budgets, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and quality.
By leading the local center of competence, the role strengthens regional capabilities, reduces reliance on global mobilization, shortens response times, and ultimately enhances customer satisfaction and profitable service delivery.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead global field service execution, including outages, overhauls, inspections, troubleshooting, and commissioning

• Own global service performance, covering safety, quality, schedule adherence, cost, margins, and customer satisfaction

• Drive the regionalization of field services by developing local skills, certifications, tools, and standardized execution practices

• Define and implement the regional field service operating model in line with global policies and standards

• Act as the primary customer interface during service execution and support Sales & Tendering with execution concepts, feasibility reviews, and cost inputs

• Lead and develop local and regional Field Service Engineers and Supervisors, fostering a strong safety culture and service mindset

• Plan and optimize regional resources, coordinating cross‑regional support only where specialized expertise or peak capacity is required

• Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and compliance with global EHS and quality requirements, while feeding field learnings back into global organizations

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• 10+ years of experience in field service or service operations within turbomachinery, power generation, or rotating equipment

• Proven leadership experience managing multi‑disciplinary field service teams

• Strong background in outage execution, maintenance, and troubleshooting

• Experience with regionalization, localization, or operating model transformation is highly desirable

• Strong safety leadership, customer focus, and cost‑ and risk‑aware decision‑making skills

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Service Center Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Service Center Administrator plays a critical role in supporting daily operations within a fast-paced service environment. This position is responsible for coordinating purchase orders, managing logistics, supporting work order processes, and maintaining accurate system transactions across multiple platforms (Salesforce and SAP). The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable wearing many hats in an unstructured, dynamic setting. Key Responsibilities

• Order & Procurement Management
• Process and manage purchase orders (POs) in Salesforce and SAP

• Receive and review POs for direct materials

• Create, place, and receive POs for indirect materials

• Establish vendor terms and maintain supplier communications

• Logistics & Operations Coordination
• Arrange transportation and logistics for pumps and related equipment

• Track materials and ensure timely delivery to support operations

• Perform receipt transactions and maintain accurate inventory records

• Work Order & Job Coordination
• Release, track, and manage work orders throughout the lifecycle

• Book jobs and ensure accurate scheduling within system tools

• Maintain status management and provide updates on work order progress

• Customer & Vendor Interaction
• Greet and assist customers and vendors in a professional manner

• Serve as a key point of contact for inquiries related to orders and services

• Financial & System Transactions
• Process invoicing activities within SAP

• Ensure accurate data entry and documentation across all systems

• Support booking and job costing activities as needed

Qualifications

• Experience coordinating purchase orders and logistics in a service or industrial environment

• Familiarity with ERP/CRM systems such as SAP and Salesforce

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, unstructured environment

• Proactive mindset with strong attention to detail

• Excellent communication and customer service skills

Key Competencies

• Adaptability and flexibility (“wear many hats”)

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Time management and prioritization

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Team-oriented with a customer-first approach

Work Environment

• Fast-paced, operations-focused service center

• Dynamic and evolving priorities

• Hands-on role requiring interaction across multiple functions

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Works Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
oversees the tendering and execution phases of projects by defining methodologies, resources, and schedules, serving as the main technical liaison with clients, and ensuring scope, quality, time, and cost objectives are met. Main tasks and responsibilities
During TENDERING PROCESS:

• Technical coordinator in detailed step/methodology, identification of the required tools, equipment and manpower.

• Point of contact between the potential client and Sulzer team for technical details, data collection, analysis, possible root causes in order to avoid reoccurrence after repair by Sulzer.

• Create Planning/schedule from mobilization, execution, testing and commissioning up to Owner’s acceptance and document submission.
During PROJECT EXECUTION:

• Project Manager roles, i.e. to manage scope, quality, time and cost of the project

• Sourcing possible local resources of skilled manpower, tools, equipment, workshop

• Attending meeting with the Client, provide response for their inquires, comments and concerns.

• Coordinate/ discuss with the respective Sulzer’s team/ division.

• Supervision of Sulzer’s team and subcontractor at site

• Project progress internal meeting and report
Technical support In developing Sulzer Philippines Service Center facility and organization

• Service center design review, construction supervision and testing of each installed equipment.

• Assess the local demand/need of further expansion of facilities

• Involve in the hiring process, training and supervision of the technical team.

• Establish Quality Control documents, procedures, reporting and documentation system.

• Create a high quality product/services to the customer’s satisfaction that will support Sulzer’s business expansion in the Philippines.

• Build and maintain close connection with client and potential client, to be able to provide a solution when needed.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?)

• Proficiency in project planning and scheduling tools

• Skilled in root cause analysis and troubleshooting techniques.

• Ability to source and manage local manpower, tools, and equipment.

• Strong client relationship management

• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Fluency in English (written and spoken) for coordination with global teams.

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work on project sites.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering

• Having >5 years experience as a manager, mainly in repairing rotating equipment

• Having knowledge in maintenance and overhaul of rotating equipment, such as turbine, compressor, generator

• Proven track record as a Project Manager or Technical Coordinator in repair, maintenance, or commissioning projects.

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical benefit
Saving Plan

jobs.title: TS FS Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
To provide hands-on technical assistance in the repair and maintenance of various equipment in the workshop or at the customer sites. Main tasks and responsibilities

• Overhaul and repair of Various type of Turbine, gear boxes, pumps, compressors, and associated other equipment such auxiliary

• Installs rotating equipment including those requiring non-standard installation procedures. Make necessary alignment/adjustment to ensure correct operation.

• Removes & dismantles equipment with maintenance problems; cleans & lubricate; repairs/replace faulty components; reassembles units and checks for efficient operation. Performs preventive & breakdown maintenance jobs.

• Uses a variety of testing equipment to diagnose trouble in proper sequence. Also, uses tools such as hydraulic press, pullers, electric drills, grinders, heating torch as well as precision tools such as micrometer, caliper gauges & dial gauges for test-checking or repair work.

• Performs/ensures maintenance work in accordance with instructions, drawings and codes of practice.

Competencies and behaviour required (What strengths needed?

• Requirement: minimum vocational high background: Automotive and Machining.

• Possess General Knowledge of mechanical and overall maintenance. Familiar with measuring tools, and general tools.

• Familiar with Assembly drawing, symbols and legend.

• Familiar with relevant standard such as API, NEMA, codes, and rules of thumbs

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required

• Fresh Graduate are welcome., 1–2-year experience in machinist role or automotive mechanic is preferred

• Production Knowledge: Precision Measuring tools/instrument such as Dial Gage, OD micrometres, ID micrometre, Callipers etc and math calculation.

• Familiar with Computer. Familiar with Drawing Software is a Plus. Hand Sketches is preferable.

• Proficient in English Language verbal and in written-Having certificate in English communication such as TOEIC is a plus.

• Basic Mechanical such as Lifting and Rigging, Metal and Alloys, Bearings, Welding, Production Processes and Shaft Alignment

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical Benefit Saving Plan

jobs.title: Deputy General Manager (Sales) - China JV
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
This role supports the execution of functional strategies, identifies opportunities for operational optimization, and ensures the delivery of high-impact business development projects. Job responsibilities

• Be responsible for driving strategy, sales growth, specially grow non CHD business in China.

• Be responsible for developing and maintaining partnerships with JV partner, within Sulzer and with external stakeholders.

• Ensure for the JV the deal structuring, pricing and all other proposal development activities interfacing with related Sulzer organizations, systems and product platform.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement strategic initiatives and monitor progress.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies and external regulations in all business development activities.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree, majored in Turbine or related engineering.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in a global industrial company lead sales management functions.

• Strong background in the Energy market focused on Solution selling and services and in particular Heavy Duty Gas Turbine Services.

• Strong negotiation, communication skills and influence.

• Good knowledge and experience in Gas Turbine technology.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

• Shuttle Bus.

jobs.title: Workshop Technician (monteur) - Meewerkend voorman (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow als Workshop Technician (monteur) - Meewerkend voorman (m/v/x) en help mee om onze service naar een next level te brengen.

In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Werkt actief mee bij het analyseren, reviseren en repareren van pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in onze werkplaats te Maastricht-Airport
• Opstellen van analyserapporten

• Coördinatie en verdeling dagelijkse werkzaamheden in het team rekening houdend met planning, prioriteiten en beschikbare capaciteit

• Bewaakt de kwaliteit, veiligheid en voortgang

• Fungeert als eerste aanspreekpunt voor de werkplaats bij technische en operationele vraagstukken

• Machinale werkzaamheden

• Uitvoeren van testen in de proefstand

Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig:
• Succesvol afgeronde technische mbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar
• Ervaring met montage van of service aan Rotating Equipment
• Affiniteit met elektrotechniek is een pré
• Technisch inzicht, je bent een echte sleutelaar
• Je beschikt over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen
• Je bent accuraat en werkt gestructureerd
• Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, Engelse taal is een pré
• Je beschikt over enige computerervaring (Word, Excel)
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling

What we offer you

Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Attractieve bonusregeling,
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer - Rotary Equipment Services (Vadodara)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for QA / QC, Quality Documents, Claims handling, Root cause analysis, Repair services of Pumps & Turbo machinery at both the service centers Vadodara & Chennai. 1. Inspection of received pumps/ turbo services for refurbishment at our service centers
• 2. Dismantling report generation elaborating the repairs possibility and define the scope of repair.
• 3. Non destructive testing as when applicable
• 4. Generation order specific QAP and ensure the operations are executed as per QAP.
• 5. NCR management & RCA for any nonconformity
• 6. Customer complaints & warranty handling
• 7. Maintaining the ISO documents for IMS certification
• 8. Involve and arrange TPI / Customer witness as requirement.
• 9. Pre-dispatch inspection and clearance with documents.
• 10. Adhere the safety compliance are being maintained during the operations and execution in service center.
• 11. Familiar with quality measurement standard instruments like, roughness measurement, MRO/ ERO, hardness tester, PMI machines.
• 12. Knowledge of ASME, ISO standards & balancing standards

• Desired experience and qualifications
• Work experience : 8+ Years (preferably) experience as a Quality Engineer from pumps background & rotary equipments
• Expertise: Quality assurance, Root cause analysis
• Education: Level: Degree or Diploma in mechanical
• Certifications: ASNT level-2
• Languages: Hindi/ English/ Gujarati (Preferred)
• Soft skills: Micro soft Office/ SAP (Preferred)

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm Servicetekniker till Servicecentret, CSS Stockholm

Sulzer är ett globalt ledande företag inom utveckling och leverans av pumpar, omrörare, luftarutrustning och blåsmaskiner till kunder inom områden som olja, gas, vatten, vattenrening gruvdrift, pappersindustri och liknande. Vi tillhandahåller en utmanande och givande arbetsmiljö där mångfald är värderad som nyckelfaktorn till framgång.

Vi söker en servicetekniker till vårt servicecenter i Stockholm. Vi erbjuder en intressant tjänst med goda möjligheter för vidare utveckling. Vårt huvudkontor ligger i Vadstena och vi har även kontor i Malmö, Göteborg, Norrköping och Stockholm samt service centers i Vadstena, Göteborg, Årsta, Järfälla, Karlstad, Arlöv och Piteå. Placeringsort för denna roll är Årsta.

Tjänsten:

I arbetet ingår bl a service, felsökning, reparation och montage av våra egna och externa produkter. Arbetet utförs på servicecentret och ute hos kund. Även vissa administrativa uppgifter ingår i tjänsten såsom arbete i vårt affärssystem SAP samt dokumentation av utförda servicearbeten. Servicecentret jobbar framförallt med kunder verksamma inom länshållning samt vatten- och avloppshantering.

Kvalifikationer:

Du har någon form av teknisk utbildning och minst 3-5 års erfarenhet av praktiskt verkstads- och fältarbete. Dessutom ska du vara tekniskt intresserad, ansvarstagande, engagerad och serviceinriktad. Du behöver kunna ta egna initiativ och vara duktig på att få saker gjorda. Du ska även vara flexibel och vilja arbeta med praktiska och en del administrativa uppgifter.
Vi är en del av ett större serviceteam och samarbetar med våra kollegor inom Sulzer Sverige. Du behöver ha lätt för att arbeta individuellt och i grupp, för att vi tillsammans skall kunna utveckla verksamheten.
I tjänsten förekommer resor framförallt inom Stockholmsområdet med omnejd. B-körkort är ett grundkrav. Övernattningar och även beredskap förekommer.

Vem är du?

Du är praktiskt lagd och har ett genuint intresse av teknik och mekanik. Grundläggande el/styr/reglerkunskaper är meriterande. Vidare är Du flexibel, kommunikativ och social, och trivs lika bra med att vara ute hos kund som att utföra arbete i vår egen verkstad. Du är välorganiserad och har en god analytisk förmåga, samarbetsvillig och självgående är tydliga drag i din personlighet.

Övrig information:
För mer information kontakta, Mikael Larsson, Årsta Servicecenter, mikael.larsson@sulzer.com

What we offer you

• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

• Gratis kaffe och frukt

• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Process Automation & Instrumentation Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join our Automation Engineering team within Chemtech division in Switzerland as Process Automation & Instrumentation Engineer to help us take our customer's experience to the next level.
In this role you will be accountable for:

• Elaboration of specifications, inquiries and ordering of all Electrical, Instrumentation and Control engineering components

• Design of loop diagrams

• Design and testing of automation solutions for our process plants

• Installation supervision and approval of plants in our production

• Sales support during the tendering phase

• Instrumentation support during commissioning of plants mainly in Europe

• Travel within Europe, approx. 10%

To succeed in this role you will need:

• A Master Degree in Mechatronics / electrical engineering / instrumentation / industrial automation or an equivalent education and ideally several years of experience in the ATEX area and process automation

• to be specialized in the specification of components for instruments and control systems

• to have practical experience in Siemens TIA Portal, as well as commission of chemical plants in hazardous areas

• to be fluent in German / English. French is a plus

• to be able to work independently, you are flexible and reliable, you identify yourself as communicative, goal and team-oriented and you are willing to travel occasionally, proactive and open for change in a dynamic and exciting field.

What we offer you

• 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays and service days)

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program

• Access to a wide range of discounts on Everyday Shopping, Entertainment and Lifestyle

• Long service awards

jobs.title: Applications and Tendering Engineer – Wastewater Treatment

titleByLocale.it: Applications and Tendering Ingegnere – Wastewater Treatment
titleByLocale.en: Applications and Tendering Engineer – Wastewater Treatment
titleByLocale.de: Applications and Tendering Ingenieur – Wastewater Treatment
titleByLocale.fr: Applications and Tendering Ingénieur – Wastewater Treatment

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Application & Tendering Engineer is responsible for developing technical and commercial solutions for municipal and industrial wastewater treatment plants, supporting the preparation of competitive bids and tenders.
The role combines process understanding, application engineering, and tendering activities, with a strong focus on selecting, designing, and integrating treatment technologies based on customer requirements, project constraints, and applicable standards.
The engineer acts as a technical interface between Sales, Engineering, and external stakeholders, contributing to solution definition from early tender stage through project handover. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Tendering & Proposal Development

• Analyze RFQs, tender documents, and technical specifications related to wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) , both civil and industrial .

• Develop complete technical and commercial proposals , ensuring compliance with process requirements, client expectations, and internal guidelines.

• Coordinate with internal departments (process engineering, mechanical engineering, procurement, finance, projects) to collect inputs for bids.

• Perform cost estimation, material take-offs, and preparation of BOQs for water and wastewater treatment solutions.

• Ensure timely and accurate submission of tenders and clarification responses.

Application Engineering & Process Support

• Provide pre-sales technical and process support to Sales and customers.

• Define and recommend process solutions and equipment for:

• Preliminary and primary treatment

• Secondary (biological) treatment

• Tertiary and polishing steps

• Sludge treatment and handling (where applicable)

• Size and configure treatment units and packages (e.g. screens, grit removal, clarification, filtration, sludge equipment).

• Prepare process descriptions, technical datasheets, layouts, and technical clarifications .

• Support and participate in technical meetings, workshops, and presentations with customers, consultants, EPC contractors, and authorities.

Client, Consultant & Vendor Interface

• Liaise with clients, consultants, technology partners, and EPC contractors to clarify process and technical aspects during the tender phase.

• Interface with suppliers and manufacturers to obtain quotations, technical data, and delivery information.

• Align technical solutions with international standards and specifications (e.g. EN, ISO, local standards, project-specific requirements).

Post‑Bid Support & Project Handover

• Follow up on submitted tenders and support post‑bid technical clarifications and negotiations .

• Contribute to contract review from a technical and scope-of-supply perspective .

• Ensure a structured handover of awarded projects to the execution team, including all technical, commercial, and process documentation.

Organizational & Knowledge Sharing

• Support and mentor junior application or tendering engineers .

• Contribute to standardization of technical solutions, tools, and templates .

• Share know‑how on wastewater treatment technologies and applications within the organization.

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering (with clear exposure to water/wastewater treatment).

• 4–7 years of experience in application engineering, tendering, or technical sales within the water and wastewater treatment sector .

• Proven experience with municipal and/or industrial wastewater treatment processes .

• Strong understanding of treatment technologies, plant layouts, and process interfaces .

• Experience in tenders for EPC or public sector projects is a strong advantage.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The workplace of this role is Xin Jiang, China.
The role is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers, and responsible for the sales plans and budgets for the assigned area. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards. Job Responsibilities

• Oversee the commissioning, installation, and testing of products and equipment at customer sites.

• Organize tenders/quotations and commercial negotiations; drive contract signing and order acquisition.

• Resolve technical issues and ensure timely and effective service delivery.

• Collaborate with internal teams to support product upgrades and customer training.

• Monitor service metrics and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.

• Manage service documentation, reporting, and administrative tasks.

• Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards.
Qualifications

• Typically a University degree and 8+ years of relevant work experience.

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or a related subject.

• Sound knowledge of rotating equipment such as pumps, turbines, compressors and motor etc.

• Experience in field service engineering or technical service management.

• Strong leadership and team supervision skills.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

• Strong customer service orientation and communication skills.

• Knowledge of industry standards and safety regulations.

What we offer you

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.

• Annual Physical Examination.

• Festival & Birthday Gifts.

• Long service awards.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
