jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Payroll Specialist is responsible for supporting accurate and compliant payroll operations using ADP for payroll processing, covering approximately 930 employees with administrative support for a broader population of up to 1,300 employees.

This role plays a key part in certified payroll reporting under the Davis-Bacon Act and provides administrative and backup support for union payroll activities.

The position focuses on payroll accuracy, compliance, reporting, and cross-functional coordination, rather than direct ownership of union payroll processing.
Payroll Processing & Administration (ADP)

• Process bi-weekly and off-cycle payrolls in ADP, ensuring accurate calculation of earnings, taxes, deductions, and garnishments.

• Review and validate payroll inputs originating from Workday (HRIS), including new hires, job changes, compensation updates, and terminations.

• Reconcile payroll data between Workday and ADP to ensure data integrity and alignment across systems.

• Perform payroll audits, balancing (gross-to-net), and variance analysis prior to payroll submission.

• Process adjustments, retroactive pay, and final pay calculations in compliance with company policy and applicable laws.

• Provide responsive, professional support for employee and manager payroll inquiries.

Certified Payroll Reporting (Davis-Bacon Act)

• Prepare and submit certified payroll reports (e.g., WH-347) for projects subject to Davis-Bacon and prevailing wage requirements.

• Collect and validate required data, including: Labor classifications
Prevailing wage rates and fringe allocations
Hours worked by project and location

• Ensure all reporting is accurate, complete, and submitted in accordance with contract and regulatory deadlines.

• Partner with Project Managers, Finance, and HR to ensure correct labor coding and project setup.

• Maintain documentation and support internal and external audits related to certified payroll compliance.

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in payroll data impacting certified payroll reporting (note: this role does not process the payroll itself for certified projects).

Union Payroll Support (Administrative & Backup)

• Serve as backup support to the primary union payroll processor.

• Assist with union reporting and administrative tasks, including: Union dues reconciliation
Benefit and pension contribution reporting
Remittance preparation and review

• Support validation of union-related payroll data and escalate discrepancies as needed.

• Stay informed of union contract changes and assist in ensuring updates are reflected in payroll processes and reporting.

Compliance, Controls & Process Improvement

• Ensure payroll operations comply with federal, state, and local wage and hour regulations.

• Maintain accurate payroll records and audit trails for compliance and internal controls.

• Support payroll-related audits, including certified payroll and union reporting reviews.

Required Qualifications

• CPP Certified

• 5+ years of payroll experience

• Experience processing multi-jurisdiction payroll

• Experience using ADP payroll systems

• Knowledge of certified payroll reporting, specifically Davis-Bacon Act requirements.

• Basic understanding of union payroll structures and reporting requirements.

• Strong Excel skills (data analysis, reconciliation, lookups).

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Le spécialiste de la paie est chargé d'appuyer des opérations de paye exactes et conformes à l'aide du PDA pour le traitement de la paye, couvrant environ 930 employés avec un soutien administratif pour une population plus large de 1 300 employés. Ce rôle joue un rôle clé dans les rapports de paie certifiés en vertu de la Loi sur Davis-Bacon et fournit un soutien administratif et de secours aux activités de paye des syndicats. Le poste est axé sur l'exactitude des états de paie, la conformité, les rapports et la coordination interfonctionnelle, plutôt que sur la propriété directe du traitement des états de paie des syndicats. Traitement et administration de la paye (ADP)
• Traiter les états de paie bihebdomadaires et hors cycle dans l'ADP, en assurant un calcul précis des gains, impôts, déductions et saisies.
• Examiner et valider les données sur les états de paie provenant de la journée de travail, y compris les nouvelles recrues, les changements d'emploi, les mises à jour sur la rémunération et les cessations d'emploi.
• Réconcilier les données de paie entre Workday et ADP pour assurer l'intégrité et l'alignement des données entre les systèmes.

• Préparer et soumettre des rapports de paie certifiés (p. ex. WH-347) pour les projets soumis à Davis-Bacon et les besoins en matière de salaires.
• Recueillir et valider les données requises, y compris les classifications du travail Taux de rémunération et allocations marginales Heures travaillées par projet et emplacement
• S'assurer que tous les rapports sont exacts, complets et soumis conformément aux délais contractuels et réglementaires.

• Tenir à jour la documentation et appuyer les audits internes et externes liés à la conformité certifiée des états de paie.
• Recenser et résoudre les écarts dans les données sur les états de paie qui influent sur les rapports de paie certifiés (note : ce rôle ne traite pas les états de paie eux-mêmes pour les projets certifiés). Soutien à la paie syndicale (administration et sauvegarde)

• Appuyer la validation des données sur les salaires des syndicats et augmenter les écarts au besoin.

• Veiller à ce que les opérations de paye soient conformes aux règlements fédéraux, des États et locaux en matière de salaires et d'heures.

• Appuyer les audits liés aux états de paie, y compris les examens certifiés des états de paie et des rapports des syndicats. Qualifications requises

Set up and operate machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. jobs.title: Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a top employer and one of the world's leading pump manufacturers. Sulzer provides a wide range of products for pumping solutions for water, oil and gas, power, and chemicals industries. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Product Development Engineer for the Technology Center in Thimister/Belgium.

This is a fantastic opportunity for you to focus on the development and standardization of products with our teams globally. As the Product Development Engineer, you will be given the opportunity to work on innovative projects ranging from design activities to product enhancement activities.

If you are talented Mechanical Engineer who is enthusiastic, self-motivated and have a passion to produce high quality engineering, we would love to hear from you! We offer you interesting and challenging tasks in a global, multi-cultural environment. This is your chance to join a leading organization, contributing to a cutting-edge initiative, and make a real impact on the future success of Sulzer.

Location: We are based in Thimister-Clermont, Belgium.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Responsible for the Product Development project activities and for achieving the project objectives.

• Design activities such as the creation of design studies, master assemblies and detailed drawings, including related design calculations.

• Coordinate detailed design drawing activities globally.

• Standardize key design features for the product range.

• Create and maintain product documentation such as design catalogues, hydraulic performance curves, product manuals and tools.

• Utilize current technologies, develop tools and methods to control designs.

• Effective communication with manufacturing entities and Product Management global organization to ensure a collaborative approach.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years’ industry experience

• Fluency in English and French

• Strong collaboration skills within a global, multicultural environment

• Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD tools (e.g. NX, SolidWorks)

• A customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate technical needs into solutions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail

What we offer you

• Continuous development opportunities, with full access to the Sulzer Learning Platform to support your personal and professional growth

• 36 days of annual leave

• A comprehensive pension and group insurance scheme designed to support your long-term security

• Private health insurance for you and your family

• Meal vouchers daily

• Global career development opportunities, with exposure to international projects and mobility across the Sulzer network

• The chance to work in an innovative, agile, and vibrant culture where your ideas and impact truly matter

Have a question about the role? Reach out to the Hiring Manager – Claude Mockels or the recruiting team – Stéphanie Piron. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingenieur Qualite Projets
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Votre mission principale sera de vous assurer du respect des exigences qualité & sûreté nucléaire tout au long de la réalisation de la commande client (de la prise de commandes jusqu’à la livraison).

Activités significatives :

Chiffrage de l’appel d’offre / commandes
- Participer au chiffrage des heures qualité dans l’établissement de l’offre client.
- Analyser les spécifications clients et leur impact sur le déroulement de l’affaire.
- Etablir les documents qualité requis au moment de l’appel d’offres.
- Réaliser une analyse de risque de non-qualité de l’appel d’offres.

Une fois l’affaire prise en commande, au moment du lancement en fabrication
- Vérification et prise en compte des spécifications qualité.
- Elaboration et préparation de toute la documentation qualité (QCP, DSI, PQP, liste AIP).
- Réalisation du programme de surveillance fournisseur.

Pendant le déroulement de l’affaire
- Mise en œuvre du programme de surveillance fournisseur.
- Gestion de la surveillance client (réalisation des convocations, participation aux inspections, …).
- Validation des documents qualité fournisseurs.
- Vérification des documents qualité interne.
- Suivre et valider le traitement des Non Conformités.
- Participation aux analyses des causes profondes et proposition d’action d’amélioration.

Après la livraison client
- Elaborer les documents de fin d’affaires (RFF, RFR, RFI, inclus DCI).
- Suivre les réclamations clients et garanties.

Compétences requises :

Compétences métier – technique

• Connaissances générales en ingénierie des matériaux (différents aciers, forge, fonderie)

• Connaissances de l’environnement industriel et métallurgie (mécanique de précision, petites et moyennes séries).

• Compétences en CND (Contrôle Non Destructif)

• Compétences en procédés de fabrication de la métallurgie.

• Connaissance de la métrologie (documentation en fonction des normes, notions de mesure) vérification des PV de métrologies

• IWE classique (soudure)

• Connaissance des techniques d’audit et d’inspection

• Anglais courant

Compétences spécifiques au nucléaire

• Maîtrise du code RCCM

• Connaissances de la norme ISO 19443 (relative à la sûreté nucléaire)

• Compétences en sûreté nucléaire (HN3)

• Connaissances des méthodes de détection de fraude et de contrefaçon

What we offer you

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Project Specialist/Order Management
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Order Coordinator is responsible for coordinating order processing activities and supporting the team in non-routine situations. This role ensures smooth communication between departments and accurate order fulfillment.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Coordinate order entry and tracking processes.
Resolve order-related issues with internal teams.
Communicate with customers regarding order status.
Maintain accurate records and update systems.
Support reporting and process improvement initiatives.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically requires advanced vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role.

Strong coordination and communication skills.
Experience in order processing or logistics.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ERP tools.
Attention to detail and ability to work independently.

This position requires the ability to perform essential job functions in an office environment, including prolonged periods of sitting, working at a computer, and communicating with others. Occasional standing, walking, and lifting of up to 10–20 pounds may be required. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening and, where applicable, ongoing testing in accordance with company policies and legal requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What we offer you

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil.

In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies.
Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.

• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)

• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).

• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;

• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;

• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.

• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;

• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)

• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role

• Excellent English. German and French are an asset

• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential

• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity

• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment

• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable.

What we offer you

• Attractive compensation and vacation plan

• Excellent social benefits

• Global development opportunities

• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture

• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation

• Employee Assistance Program

• Long service awards

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Purpose of the job
Supports CAE activities for ORE, PD and CT projects globally. Compilation of mechanical analysis documentation provided to clients, proving the mechanical, rotordynamic and structural integrity of products, ensuring conformity to established industry, company standards and customer specifications

Main tasks and responsibilities

• Rotordynamic analysis (Lateral and Torsional) of centrifugal pumps.

• Pump design calculations as per international standards.

• Structural and Dynamic analysis of Baseplate and Vertical Pump using ANSYS Workbench

• Preparation & submission of calculation reports and coordinating for customer approvals.

• Provide technical assistance to project team to solve possible discrepancies & review and issue and follow-up the comments on reports, specifications, etc.

• Making design recommendations to provide acceptable rotordynamic level, behavior of pump and help to resolve difficult or unusual product design engineering problems.

• Capable of performing routine mechanical engineering calculations and analysis.

Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Relevant experience in Rotating machine industry practices & standards.

• Experience in finite element analysis techniques and calculations

• Experience of rotor dynamics, FEA using Ansys

• Solid understanding of structural mechanics fundamentals and basic vibration

• Knowledge of in 2D/3D CAD & PLM software

• Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, word and power point

jobs.title: ASM2 - tendering Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. On time Submission of tenders
• Techno commercially optimum and competitive offers
• On time submission and closure of technical clarifications, Technical bid clarification meeting as required
• Clear handover of the project to project team after order, attending ORM
• Close project open points if any and attend customer KOM if required
• Analyze RFQs, tenders, and bid documents for centrifugal pumps (API 610, ISO, ANSI, API 610 / ISO 5199 / ISO 2858 / client specs)
• horizontal/vertical, multistage, etc.)
• Basic Knowledge for Bought out items like, Mechanical Seal & Seal Plan, Motors, Lube Oil System
• Prepare commercial offers , BOQ-based pricing, and option sheets.
• Co-ordinate with Procurement for bought‑out items, factory for delivery timelines & Sales for commercial terms and margins.
• Provide pre‑bid clarifications and participate in technical discussions
• Support sales teams during during Negotiations & Pre- Bid technical Justifications
• Enquiry and evaluation of subcontractor offers as well as corresponding expediting
• Review quote received and challenge as necessary internal as well as external stakeholders to ensure a competitive proposal is submitted meeting Sales / market expectation

What we offer you

• 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
• Defined contribution pension scheme
• Hospitalization insurance benefit
• On-site car parking
• Subsidized cafeteria
• Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This includes establishing standards for pollution control, testing, and maintenance, and recommending new equipment and systems.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.
• Provide technical support to the Sales and Tendering teams throughout the bidding process.

• Review pump selections prepared by the Tendering team to ensure technical compliance and optimization.

• Review and interpret client specifications, particularly for critical or special requirements.

• Coordinate with the Design Responsible (DR) team to obtain additional technical inputs and solutions.

• Interact directly with customers to understand specific application needs and incorporate them into the design layout.

• Liaise with suppliers to resolve technical queries and obtain necessary clarifications.

• Coordinate with other Sulzer legal entities (SPUK, SPDE, SPSZH, SPUSA) to obtain technical support and share expertise.

• Provide technical assistance to the Costing department during the bidding stage.

• Prepare preliminary Pump General Arrangement (GA) drawings for customer submission.

• Estimate “not‑to‑exceed” dimensions based on pump selection and buyout drawings.

• Coordinate with Order Engineering teams (Hydraulics, Bare Pump, Packaging, Instrumentation, Electrical, etc.) to address special or non‑standard requirements.

• Support and collaborate with Operations, Purchase, Sales, and Tendering teams during technical evaluations.

• Proactively support company initiatives that promote safe working practices, environmental protection, and continuous improvement.

What we offer you

22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays
Defined contribution pension scheme
Hospitalization insurance benefit
On-site car parking
Subsidized cafeteria
Long service award

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Procurement Administrator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer GT Aero (formerly Alba Power) is a global leader in gas turbine maintenance, repair and overhaul, supporting critical energy infrastructure worldwide. Now part of Sulzer’s renowned rotating equipment services business, we combine decades of engineering expertise with a strong focus on supply chain excellence, partnering with suppliers to deliver quality, cost efficiency and reliability at scale.

We are currently looking for a Procurement Administrator to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to support a high-performing procurement function, managing supplier data, processing purchase orders and helping ensure smooth, efficient supply chain operations. Ideal for someone organised, detail-focused and keen to build a career in procurement within a global engineering business. Job Responsibilities

• Process purchase requisitions and convert them into purchase orders accurately and in a timely manner.

• Maintain and update supplier information, including contact details, pricing agreements, and performance records.

• Assist in the preparation of Request for Quotations (RFQs) and Request for Proposals (RFPs), circulating them to potential suppliers.

• Track and expedite orders, ensuring on-time delivery and resolving any supply chain issues or delays.

• Generate procurement reports, including spend analysis, supplier performance, and inventory levels.

• Support the negotiation of favorable terms and conditions with suppliers.

Job Qualifications

• Proven experience in an administrative or support role, preferably within a procurement or supply chain department.

• Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) is highly desirable.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to task completion.

• Knowledge of procurement principles and practices is a plus.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Company-wide bonus scheme

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Serviceleder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Service i Sulzer er et spennende og interessant fagfelt, og har ofte et høyt tempo. Det å bidra til at folk har rent vann og fungerende infrastruktur for vann- og avløp er et av de viktigste samfunnsoppdragene som finnes! Vi trives best med flere baller i luften, i et arbeidsmiljø hvor kreativitet og rasjonalitet går hånd i hånd. Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt.
Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss!

Stillingen inneholder blant annet:

• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.

• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.

• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.

• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.

• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.

• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.

• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang.

Hovedoppgaver
Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:

• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.

• Personalansvar for teknikerne

• Kundekontakt og befaringer

• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet

• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt

• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner.

Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge

Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning

• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse

• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende

• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr

• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.

• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt

• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg

• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk

• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)

• Gode kunnskaper innen IT

Personlige styrker

• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer

• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team

• Kundeorientert

• Teknisk nysgjerrighet

What we offer you

Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg?
Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk.
Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri.

Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

Vi liker kort avstand mellom verksted og ledelse, hvor ideer blir hørt og hvor muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling blir gitt. Sulzer søker nå etter en fagsterk og kundeorientert serviceleder. Du kommer til å være lokalisert ved vårt verksted på hovedkontoret i Asker, og også ha personalansvar for teknikerne på flere lokasjoner. Har du dokumenterte erfaringer med å skape, lede, og utvikle effektive team, håper vi at nettopp du ønsker å være med på denne reisen med oss! Stillingen inneholder blant annet:
• Du vil være en del av et team med 2 serviceledere, som tilsammen har personalansvar for alle teknikerne.
• Du vil være ansvarlig for salg av servicetjenester, driften av og effektiv bruk av ressursene, både menneskelige og materielle. Sulzer har stort fokus på kontinuerlig forbedring, utvikling, og vekst.
• Vi ønsker at du er en rollemodell, at du viser engasjement og felles retning.
• Sørge for at de ansatte får et tett og effektivt samarbeid, slik at de blir inspirert til å oppnå felles suksess.
• Sikre at teknikerne har riktig kompetanse for å utføre avdelingens arbeid, gjennom kompetanseutvikling og ansettelser, i samråd med serviceleder i Norge.
• I og med at våre serviceteknikere jobber med tungt maskineri og med arbeid som kan være risikopreget, er det svært viktig at leder har stort fokus på å drifte på en sikker og helsefremmende måte, og sikrer HMS og kvalitet i alle ledd.
• Dette er en operativ rolle, som består av både ledelse og salg, samt administrative oppgaver som bidrar til å holde hjulene i gang. Hovedoppgaver Arbeidsoppgavene inkluderer, men er ikke begrenset til:
• HMS ansvar for teknikerne og verkstedene.
• Personalansvar for teknikerne
• Kundekontakt og befaringer
• Salgsrelaterte oppgaver på serviceområdet
• Ansvar for servicebiler/flåtestyring lokalt
• Det er behov for en del reising i stillingen, for å vise tilstedeværelse på flere lokasjoner. Rapporterer til: Serviceleder Norge Ønsket erfaring og formell utdanning
• Gjerne utdanning på BSc- nivå, eller teknisk utdannelse
• Operativ ledelseserfaring, gjerne fra bransje med serviceteknikere i felt eller lignende
• Erfaring innen vedlikehold av prosessutstyr eller annet mekanisk utstyr
• Det er en fordel å kjenne til vann- og avløpsbransjen.
• Kompetanse innen HMS for arbeid i felt
• Kompetanse eller interesse for tilstøtende fagdisipliner; mekaniske, elektro, automasjon og bygg & anlegg
• Gode kommunikasjonsevner på både norsk og engelsk
• Førerkort klasse B, fordel med BE (henger)
• Gode kunnskaper innen IT Personlige styrker
• Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
• Komfortabel med elektroniske verktøy og systemer
• Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper, og evne til å skape og lede et team
• Kundeorientert
• Teknisk nysgjerrighet What we offer you Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Sulzer er en stor og stabil arbeidsgiver, og samtidig har vi et lokalt miljø som er liten og dynamisk. Sulzer er kjent for produkter med høy kvalitet, har en solid ordrereserve, egne fabrikker, og er en ledende aktør i en bærekraftig og livsnødvendig industri. Ansatte hos oss har stor påvirkningskraft på egen hverdag og bedriftens retning. Sulzer tilbyr et hyggelig miljø med høy yrkesstolthet og faglig tyngde. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, og fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og ikke minst gode muligheter for videreutvikling internt og eksternt

jobs.title: Internal Quality Auditor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The entry-level Internal Quality Auditor is responsible for the execution of day-to-day quality assurance activities. This includes setting operational objectives, ensuring adherence to quality standards, and resolving routine quality issues. Key Responsibilities:

• Implement and maintain QESH management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001.

• Ability and willingness to travel to Service Centers across the US 5-7 times per year.

• Conduct internal audits, inspections, and risk assessments across production areas.

• Lead incident investigations, identify root causes, and track corrective actions.

• Provide training and guidance to employees on QESH policies and safe work practices.

• Monitor and report on QESH KPIs, including non-conformities, near misses, and environmental metrics.

• Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other relevant regulatory requirements.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and lean manufacturing efforts

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate QESH into daily operations.

• Maintain documentation and prepare for external audits and customer inspections.

• Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory quality standards.

• Investigate and resolve routine quality issues.

• Support audits and continuous improvement initiatives

Requirements:

• Intermediate knowledge of MS Word MS Excel required

• Basic knowledge or MS SharePoint and MS PowerPoint preferred

• 1+ years of experience in Internal Quality Audits preferred but not required

• Knowledge of quality assurance practices and tools.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking.

• Effective communication and documentation abilities.

• Familiarity with manufacturing environments.

• Experience in ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 environments preferred

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• 401k with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer Industry
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.

This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Key Responsibilities

• Assist in preparing and delivering technical presentations.

• Support the development of customized solutions based on client needs in the area/customers of responsibility.

• Process the orders so Order entry people can transfer the order to factories.

• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure feasibility of proposals.

• Respond to customer inquiries and provide technical support.

• Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

• Maintain accurate records of sales activities and customer interactions.

​ Skills & Qualifications

• Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and up to 2 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

• Strong interest in technology and sales.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM tools.

• Team player with a proactive mindset.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Restaurant tickets

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• Other fringe benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key 
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

What we offer you

target bonus:18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: APT Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Application Engineering Lead is responsible for providing technical advice and support to sales teams, conducting technical analysis of product configurations, and ensuring customer-specific solutions meet technical and commercial requirements. This role includes preparing and delivering technical briefings, estimating costs and resources, and supporting implementation.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Prepare technical and commercial quotations; attend technical presentation and clarification meeting; technical appendix negotiation; attend commercial bidding and order negotiation, contract preparation / negotiation and risk control
• 2. Monitor / update project status in system regularly
• 3. Market Analysis and business promotion when needed
• 4. Internal handover meeting preparation
• 5. Assistant to attend column start up, plant test run and trouble shooting
• 6. Follow ISO procedure and Office 5s maintenance
• 7. Other tasks assigned by APT Manager/Team leader
• REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE
1. Minimum 1-3 years’ work experience as chemical engineer / plant engineer / process engineer in refinery, coal chemicals, environmental, petrochemicals, fine & specialty chemicals plant, with plant operation and DCS control practices will be more appreciated, or 1-3 years’ work experience as process engineer in engineering company in above mentioned market
• 2. Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, Master's degree is preferred
• 3. Fluent in both oral & written English and Mandarin
• 4. Fluent use MS office such as WORD /EXECL /PowerPoint
• 5. Fluent use simulation software such as Pro-II or Aspen would be additional benefit
• 6. Customer oriented, Teamwork in mind, Strong committed to achieve results
• 7. Positive attitude, Open-minded, Good communication skills
• 8. Ready to work under pressure. Available for frequent traveling
• 9. Awareness to work in an international environment

What we offer you

target bonus:18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Lead Piping Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising a team of mechanical engineers and support staff engaged in the design, development, and testing of mechanical systems and components. This role ensures that engineering projects are executed efficiently, meet technical and quality standards, and align with organizational goals. The supervisor also plays a key role in mentoring junior engineers, managing project timelines, and fostering innovation in mechanical design and manufacturing processes.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. 设置该岗位的目的:
Purpose of the Job:

As a Principal Piping Engineer, you will participate in Sulzer projects at all execution stages (Conceptual design, Skid and Modular design, DD, Procurement / Construction / Commissioning support etc.).
Principal Piping Engineer reports to the Chief Piping Engineer and/or Engineering Manager.
主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Take lead in overall piping design of skid

• Act as overall mechanical engineering IC in skid projects

• Train and guide piping engineers

• Design, 3D modeling and review of main metal structures of skids and modules

• Piping stress analysis

• Development of the drawings and other design documents within discipline

• Material selection within discipline

• Value engineering within discipline

• Interface management

• Participate in the development of technical specifications for design, technical requirements for supply, etc.

• Supervision and support of subcontractors' activities

• Checking and approval documentation from subcontractors.

• Participation in the development of design philosophy and internal standards within the discipline

• Participation in the project meetings, 3D models review etc.

• Contribute to development of the overall project schedule.

• Tracking and managing changes within discipline

• Participation in the project progress report development.

职位要求：
Qualifications:
Education and Experience

• Bachelor in Mechanical Engineering

• 10 years’ experience in the oil and gas industries.

• Good knowledge of applicable industrial standards and best practices. (China & International)

• Good knowledge of designing methods and economic analysis.

• Extensive experience in skid and modular design

• General knowledge of oil and gas plant construction.

Language

• Fluent in Mandarin and English

Others

• Ability to work under tight deadlines with multiple tasks.

• Ability to work in multiple projects.

• Ability to travel on business trips including lengthy business trips to site during construction and commissioning.

What we offer you

target bonus：18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer

titleByLocale.it: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Ingegnere
titleByLocale.en: Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Chaîne d'approvisionnement Management & Purchasing Ingénieur

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Supervisor is responsible for supervising procurement professionals and ensuring the effective sourcing and acquisition of goods and services. This includes managing supplier relationships and ensuring compliance with procurement policies.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. The Senior Supply Chain Management & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

Depending on workload, this position will be assigned to functions in the Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management and Advanced Procurement function. The role works closely with all cross‑functional teams across the organization, supporting their sourcing needs to ensure timely, cost‑effective, and quality‑compliant delivery aligned with project and business objectives.

A background in EPC environments is an advantage, along with experience in site procurement, construction, or working within an engineering‑driven setting. Exposure to international procurement is also a plus.

设置该岗位的目的:

The Senior SCM & Purchasing Engineer is responsible for driving strategic sourcing while applying procurement engineering expertise in Supply Chain Management. The role focuses on identifying and securing cost‑optimized products and services required for Process Solutions’ own production and project execution.

主要任务与职责:
Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Identify and develop qualified best-fit suppliers for various demands of engineered equipment, materials, subcontracting need for Sulzer packages

• Conduct market research, TCO analysis (within Sulzer Scope coverage), and supply chain risk assessments.

• Support sourcing initiatives on product line development and source for the most cost‑effective sources.

• Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of industry trends, technologies, and supplier capabilities, lesson learns to support team innovation

• Vendor Management

• Evaluate, qualify, and assess suppliers' technical capability, quality standards, and capacity Manage supplier performance, conduct audits, and drive corrective actions where needed. Maintain accurate supplier records (credentials, ISO, Financial, audit records, performance in Sulzer digital dashboard, and other files. Support Quality team in the corrective actions for in case of NCR and tracking of COPQ

• Project Procurement Support (when activated)

• Will be working in Advanced Procurement team while collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Project Management, Workshop to meet project procurement needs and timelines. Provide regular procurement status reports, risk assessments, and mitigation plans. Manage end-to-end procurement cycle including RFQ’s, commercial bid evaluations. Lead negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, favorable terms, while aligned to the total cost of ownership (within Sulzer scope). Issue purchase orders, monitor order progress for buy outs, work with Quality and Project Manag

jobs.title: ESH Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Main tasks and responsibilities:
- Implement applicable national workplace safety laws and regulations, standards and specifications, and the company’s safety management system; implement the safety production responsibility system.
- Conduct daily on-site safety inspections and hazard identification and rectification. Focus on high-risk activities such as machinery operations, welding, chemical use, dust-related work, working at height, hot work, temporary electrical work, and heavy lifting/handling.
- Supervise workers correct wearing and use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and promptly stop the “three violations” (unauthorized command, unsafe/unauthorized operation, and violation of work discipline).
- Organize three-level safety induction training for new employees, pre-job/toolbox safety briefings, special safety training, and emergency drills to enhance safety awareness and emergency response capability.
- Participate in permit-to-work approvals and on-site monitoring for hazardous operations; verify work conditions, control measures, and personnel qualifications to ensure compliant execution.
- Conduct periodic inspection, maintenance, and management of fire-fighting facilities, emergency equipment, and protective supplies to ensure they are in good condition and effective.
- Improve safety signs, warning boards, and safety communication materials, and promote on-site safety culture.
- Participate in the investigation and handling of safety incidents/accidents; perform root-cause analysis, record and report findings, and track implementation of corrective actions.
- Establish and maintain safety records, inspection logs, training files, and hazard rectification closure records to ensure they are standardized and complete.
- Complete other workplace safety management tasks assigned by supervisors.

What we offer you

target bonus：15% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Main tasks and responsibilities: - Focus on Guangxi &Guizhou，Hunan & Hubei province business. - Dig more inquiry for TAS &Revamping project, organize technical presentation or clarification meeting if needed, attend commercial bidding and price negotiation. Contract detail up. - Maintain good relationship with customers, continuous enhance market share. - Manage, guide customers and achieve area targets and results by synergy together with other area sales - Visit customer timely by providing technical advice and proposal. - Providing sales forecast and visit &Lost reports; Update weekly plan and execute accordingly to make sure clear target. - Fight plan for key project and good at seeking opportunity. - Attend sales meeting & internal training for self-improvement - Co-ordinate with Procurement, Engineering, Workshop etc departments for products delivery to perfect Sales’ KPI. - Provides timely feedback to senior manager for assigned task - Other tasks by GM, Head of sales or High Management assigned.
• What we offer you target bonus：25% of annual income Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Lead is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting detailed analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This includes preparing technical sales briefings, evaluating customer specifications, and ensuring proposals meet quality standards.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key 
• Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements and prepare accurate technical proposals.
Estimate costs, resources, and timelines for customized product solutions.
Conduct technical briefings and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering and sales teams to ensure proposal feasibility.
Ensure compliance with company standards and customer expectations.
Support troubleshooting and initial training during implementation phases.
Skills & 
• Qualifications
Typically a University degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 3–4 years of relevant experience (or equivalent skills) are minimally required to carry out the role.

Required Skills:

Strong technical knowledge of industrial products and systems.
Experience in tendering, proposal development, and cost estimation.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.

What we offer you

target bonus:18.33% of annual income

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Process Engineering Supervisor
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Process Engineering Supervisor is responsible for supervising expert-level engineers in the development and optimization of manufacturing processes. This role ensures operational efficiency and supports continuous improvement initiatives.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles. Résumé du poste**

En tant que Superviseur Ingénierie des Procédés, vous serez responsable de l'optimisation, de la gestion et de la supervision des processus de fabrication au sein de notre usine, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et la sécurité.

Responsabilités**

* Superviser et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens en procédés.
* Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser des processus de fabrication pour améliorer la productivité, réduire les coûts et garantir la qualité des produits.
* Analyser les données de production et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration continue des processus.
* Élaborer et maintenir la documentation technique des procédés, y compris les schémas de tuyauterie et d'instrumentation (P&ID), les procédures opérationnelles standard (SOP) et les instructions de travail.
* Participer à la sélection, à l'installation et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements de production.
* Assurer la conformité des processus aux normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité (ISO, etc.).
* Collaborer étroitement avec les départements de production, de maintenance, de R&D et de qualité.
* Gérer les projets d'amélioration des procédés, y compris la planification, le suivi du budget et le respect des délais.
* Former et développer les compétences de votre équipe.

Qualifications**

* Diplôme d'ingénieur en génie des procédés, génie chimique, mécanique ou domaine connexe.
* Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie des procédés dans un environnement industriel, avec une expérience significative en supervision ou gestion d'équipe.
* Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies d'optimisation des procédés (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.).
* Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse technique.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe dans un environnement dynamique.
* Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais technique (écrit et oral).
* Connaissance des logiciels de simulation de processus (par exemple, Aspen Plus, HYSYS) serait un plus.
* Expérience dans l'industrie des pompes, de la compression ou de l'équipement rotatif serait un atout.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Résumé du poste** En tant que Superviseur Ingénierie des Procédés, vous serez responsable de l'optimisation, de la gestion et de la supervision des processus de fabrication au sein de notre usine, en assurant l'efficacité, la qualité et la sécurité. Responsabilités** * Superviser et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens en procédés. * Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser des processus de fabrication pour améliorer la productivité, réduire les coûts et garantir la qualité des produits. * Analyser les données de production et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration continue des processus. * Élaborer et maintenir la documentation technique des procédés, y compris les schémas de tuyauterie et d'instrumentation (P&ID), les procédures opérationnelles standard (SOP) et les instructions de travail. * Participer à la sélection, à l'installation et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements de production. * Assurer la conformité des processus aux normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité (ISO, etc.). * Collaborer étroitement avec les départements de production, de maintenance, de R&D et de qualité. * Gérer les projets d'amélioration des procédés, y compris la planification, le suivi du budget et le respect des délais. * Former et développer les compétences de votre équipe. 
• Qualifications** * Diplôme d'ingénieur en génie des procédés, génie chimique, mécanique ou domaine connexe. * Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie des procédés dans un environnement industriel, avec une expérience significative en supervision ou gestion d'équipe. * Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies d'optimisation des procédés (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.). * Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse technique. * Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe dans un environnement dynamique. * Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais technique (écrit et oral). * Connaissance des logiciels de simulation de processus (par exemple, Aspen Plus, HYSYS) serait un plus. * Expérience dans l'industrie des pompes, de la compression ou de l'équipement rotatif serait un atout.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer’s Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for advanced design and manufacturing, specialising in OEM pump technology and engineered solutions for critical industrial applications. This site brings together cutting-edge engineering capability, digital design, and high-precision manufacturing, supporting sectors such as energy, water, chemicals, and infrastructure.

With significant recent investment, our Leeds operations are evolving rapidly—enhancing our capabilities in advanced machining, digital engineering, testing, and product innovation. This is where new business pumps are brought to life from cradle to grave—from initial concept and design through to manufacture, testing, delivery, and lifecycle support. We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of complex, high-value pump projects within our new business portfolio. You will play a critical role in managing the end-to-end project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and manage multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle – from bid handover through design, manufacturing, and final delivery

• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring strong relationships and clear communication

• Drive project planning, scheduling, risk management, and cost control

• Coordinate cross-functional teams including design engineering, production, procurement, and quality

• Ensure compliance with contractual, technical, and regulatory requirements

• Identify and manage risks and opportunities, implementing mitigation strategies

What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience as a Project Manager within engineering, manufacturing, or OEM environments

• Strong knowledge of complex mechanical equipment, ideally pumps or rotating equipment

• Demonstrated experience delivering high-value, technically complex projects

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• Strong commercial awareness, including budget control and contract management

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment

• Project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP) desirable

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• Competitive base salary

• Annual bonus, based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance through Aviva

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Aero Mechanic is responsible for the safe coordination of assembly and disassembly of all aero derivative machinery. They inspect and diagnose malfunctions and reliably fix machinery in compliance with safety regulations. Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, and assemble power turbines, gas generators, and accessory gear associated with aeroderivative machinery

• Possess a proficient knowhow of professional hand tools to adequately perform daily assignments.

• Continuously gain knowledge of products, materials, and procedures to better perform duties including updating safety processes.

• Keep the work areas clean and well-organized during disassembly, inspection, assembly, and when the job is completed.

• Be ready to travel to job site when called with tools and safety equipment.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• Hands-on shop and/or field service experience in aero-derivative turbomachinery repair.

• Technical knowledge of aero-derivative turbomachinery repair.

• 4+ years of aeroderivative machinery experience is preferred but not required.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics

titleByLocale.it: Senior Finanza Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.en: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.de: Senior Finanzen Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Finance Business Partner to support our Services business across the UK & Nordics region. In this strategic role, you will combine deep financial expertise with strong business acumen to guide decision‑making, improve performance, and ensure financial insights are embedded at every level of the organisation.

As a key partner to regional leadership, you will play a critical part in shaping the future direction of the business - helping drive sustainable growth, profitability, and operational excellence across multiple sites and service lines.

The role can be based at our Birmingham or Leeds facilities.

What you’ll do:

• Develop and review strategic plans at a regional, business unit, or divisional level, providing financial insights to support long-term growth and business strategies

• Establish and maintain comprehensive performance management frameworks for cross-functional and geographically diverse teams

• Manage major capital programs and oversee costing, pricing and profitability modelling.

• Partner with senior leaders, shaping strategy and ensuring financial alignment with business goals.

• Support project reviews and provide expert financial guidance through the full project lifecycle.

What you’ll bring:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or similar.

• 7–10 years’ experience in leadership in finance or business planning, ideally within the industrial, engineering services or manufacturing sectors.

• Strong stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence senior decision‑makers.

• Excellent communication skills, translating complex financial insights for non‑financial audiences.

• Advanced MS Office skills; experience with Tagetik, Qlik Sense or ERP systems is a plus.

What we offer you

• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy

• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.

• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

If you're a strategic thinker with strong business acumen and a passion for partnering with leadership to drive performance, we’d love to hear from you.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Finance Business Partner commercialmente pensato per supportare il nostro business Servizi in tutta la regione del Regno Unito & Nordics. In questo ruolo strategico, si combinano competenze finanziarie profonde con un forte acume aziendale per guidare il processo decisionale, migliorare le prestazioni e garantire che gli insight finanziari sono incorporati a ogni livello dell'organizzazione. Come partner chiave per la leadership regionale, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione della direzione futura del business - aiutando a guidare la crescita sostenibile, la redditività e l'eccellenza operativa in più siti e linee di servizio. Il ruolo può essere basato presso le nostre strutture Birmingham o Leeds. Cosa farai:
• Sviluppare e rivedere piani strategici a livello regionale, aziendale o divisionale, fornendo informazioni finanziarie per sostenere la crescita a lungo termine e le strategie aziendali
• Stabilire e mantenere un quadro completo di gestione delle prestazioni per i team interfunzionali e geograficamente diversi
• Gestire i principali programmi di capitale e supervisionare la modellazione dei costi, dei prezzi e della redditività.
• Partner con leader senior, strategia di modellazione e allineamento finanziario con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Sostenere le recensioni dei progetti e fornire una guida finanziaria esperta attraverso il ciclo di vita del progetto completo. Cosa porterai:
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o simili.
• Esperienza di 7-10 anni nella leadership nella finanza o nella pianificazione aziendale, idealmente all’interno dei servizi industriali, ingegneristici o industriali.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di influenzare i decisori senior.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, traducendo complesse intuizioni finanziarie per il pubblico non finanziario.
• Avanzate competenze di MS Office; l'esperienza con Tagetik, Qlik Sense o sistemi ERP è un plus. Cosa ti offriamo
