jobs.title: Service Centre Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Leeds Service Centre. This is a pivotal, leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Leeds service centre brings together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating equipment. Supporting customers across key sectors including power generation, renewables, water, and general industry, the team is focused on reliability, innovation, and delivering strong customer outcomes.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Own the P&L for the Leeds Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.

• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.

• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.

• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.

• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.

• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).

• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.

• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across in an Service / Aftermarket / Industrial Engineering environment

• Experience in business management and P&L ownership,

• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.

• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.

• LEAN/Continuous Improvement experience (desirable).

• NEBOSH qualification (desirable).

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution

• Private Medical Insurance

• Car / Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

The Engineering Intern works closely with the engineering department to assist with technical projects, design tasks, manufacturing processes, analysis, and documentation to gain practical, hands-on industry experience in nuclear rotating equipment design, manufacturing, and refurbishment.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTION:

• Provide technical support for projects, including design, testing, and engineering calculations.

• Assist in creating and modifying drawings or models using CAD software.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Assist in creating technical reports, manuals, and documentation for projects.

• Interface with cross-functional teams (quality, manufacturing) to solve problems.

SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and Environmental Safety & Health (ESH) Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Supports and cooperates in company-wide Quality Management effort.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Currently enrolled as a Junior or Senior in an accredited B.S. program in Mechanical Engineering.

• Basic understanding of engineering principles, calculations, and design software.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and CAD tools.

• Eagerness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

What we offer you

What we offer:

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. JOB SUMMARY:
The Tendering & Purchasing Specialist is responsible for managing the end‑to‑end tendering, sourcing, and purchasing activities for materials, components, and services used in the manufacture of safety‑related and non‑safety‑related nuclear power plant parts. This role ensures compliance with stringent nuclear quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures while achieving cost, quality, and delivery objectives. The ideal candidate must have the ability to interpret Bills of Materials (BOMs) and technical drawings to accurately estimate costs and prepare proposals. This role requires close collaboration with sales, engineering, procurement, and finance teams to develop winning submissions and support business growth.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Prepare and manage RFQs, tenders, and purchase orders
· Evaluate supplier offers for commercial, technical, and quality compliance
· Negotiate pricing, lead times, and terms
· Ensure adherence to nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements
· Coordinate with engineering, quality, and production teams
· Track orders, expedite deliveries, and resolve supplier issues

SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Keep department manager apprised of future opportunities.

• Advise management of changes in current order and tender status.

• Actively involved with standardization and continuous improvement processes.

• Maintain quote and order files.

• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and QESH Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in tendering, purchasing, cost estimation, or bid management in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

• Proficiency in reading and interpreting BOMs and technical drawings.

• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and cost structures.

• Experience with ERP systems (SAP), SalesForce and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) preferred but not required.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.

• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

What we offer you

Country Benefits:

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project Engineer is responsible for the design and execution of packaged control and power solutions from order kickoff through FAT and turnover. Typical scope includes control system design, MCCs, MV/LV VFDs, RVSSs, PLSs, RTUs, and field instrumentation. This role owns technical coordination, submittals, documentation, schedule/budget tracking for the I&C portion, and factory acceptance testing readiness and execution. The I&C Project Engineer is not responsible for installation, however, is responsible for customer engagement, witnessing FAT testing on location, etc.. Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

• Travel: Up to 25–40% based on project needs (regional and occasional out-of-state).

• Typical travel purposes: Customer/site walks, design coordination meetings, pre-FAT reviews, customer witness FAT, inspections, interface meetings with the GC/EC/customer, troubleshooting, and post-shipment technical support meetings (non-installation).

• Duration: Most trips 1–3 days; occasional trips up to 1 week for major FATs or multi-package projects.

• Schedule flexibility: Ability to travel on short notice at times to support critical project milestones (e.g., customer witness FAT windows).

• Physical demands: Ability to work in shop and industrial environments around large equipment; may require standing/walking for extended periods, and climbing ladders/stairs.

• Site conditions: Exposure to industrial hazards (noise, dust, weather, moving equipment) while adhering to required PPE and site safety rules.

Scope of Supply (Typical)

• Control system design (instrumentation and control architecture, integration, and interfaces)

• MCC lineups and associated controls

• Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and controls (as applicable)

• Reduced Voltage Soft Starters (RVSS) and controls (as applicable)

• RTUs / PLC panels (as applicable to contract)

• Field instruments (specified instruments and accessories)

• Switchboards (SWBD) as part of package supply (startup/energization excluded) Associated drawings, submittals, test documentation, owner trainings, and FAT execution

Core Responsibilities
1) Control System Design (Primary Technical Ownership)

Develop the overall control system approach based on project requirements, including:

• Control architecture (RTU/PLC/remote I/O concepts where applicable)

• Communications and integration philosophy (protocols, network topology, addressing strategy)

• Power and control interface requirements between MCC/VFD/RVSS/RTU and instrumentation

Produce and/or review design deliverables as required by the contract and internal standards:

• I/O lists, instrument lists, control narratives/cause & effect (when required)

• Loop diagrams, termination drawings, and interconnects

• Panel drawings (wiring diagrams, layouts, BOMs) and integration details

• Network diagrams and communications mappings (when applicable)

Ensure designs are buildable, testable (FAT-ready), and aligned with customer standards and project constraints.

Coordinate design reviews and address comments to closure prior to shop release.

2) Project Execution & Coordination (Delivery Ownership)

• Own the I&C/controls portion of project execution: deliverables, schedule, budget awareness, and quality.

• Review contract documents and customer standards; translate requirements into a deliverables list and execution plan.

• Coordinate across internal engineering, integration teams, procurement, QA, and project stakeholders.

• Manage submittal flow: compile, review, and submit vendor data; track comments; close out resubmittals.

• Provide clear status updates; maintain action-item logs, decision records, and interface registers.

• Manage change

jobs.title: Service Technician / Technicien Service
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Technicien Service passionné et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance, du diagnostic et de la réparation de nos équipements sur site et en atelier.

Responsabilités du poste

* Effectuer l'installation, la mise en service, la maintenance préventive et corrective des pompes, agitateurs et équipements rotatifs de Sulzer chez les clients.
* Réaliser des diagnostics techniques précis et identifier les causes des pannes ou dysfonctionnements.
* Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés, incluant les actions réalisées, les pièces remplacées et les recommandations pour le client.
* Assurer un support technique aux clients, les conseiller sur l'utilisation et l'entretien de leurs équipements.
* Participer à la formation des clients sur l'utilisation et la maintenance de base des produits.
* Respecter scrupuleusement les procédures de sécurité et les normes de qualité en vigueur.
* Gérer les stocks de pièces détachées nécessaires aux interventions.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes commerciales et d'ingénierie pour améliorer la satisfaction client.
* Participer aux interventions fixées

Qualifications requises

* Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Technicien Service ou dans un rôle similaire, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes, des équipements rotatifs ou de l'industrie lourde.
* Diplôme technique (BTS, DUT) en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique ou équivalent.
* Solides compétences en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel.
* Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques et électriques.
* Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure.
* Permis de conduire valide (déplacements fréquents à prévoir).
* Bonnes aptitudes relationnelles, sens du service client et autonomie.
* Capacité à travailler de manière indépendante et en équipe.
* Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral). Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.
* Habilitations électriques à jour (B1V, BR, H0V) seraient un avantage.
* Connaissance des produits Sulzer serait appréciée.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Commercial Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Tendering Manager is responsible for managing a team of professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports the sales process with technical expertise. 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director where appropriate
• 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines
• 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all members of the allocated team
• 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis
• 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director
• 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified
• 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that resource in all groups.
8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects.
9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and bid decision.
10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst meeting SPZA targets
11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the delegation of authority guidelines
12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the profit margin on SPZA tenders
13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible
14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work, material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements.
• 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval.
• 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this criteria
• 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time
• 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs.
• 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry.
• 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner
• 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status
22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on contractual rights, remedies which has been taken into consideration during tendering.
23. Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement.

jobs.title: Senior QC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Ensures quality and technical compliance in servicing rotating equipment, including pumps, turbines, and compressors. Ensures adherence to Sulzer OEM, customer, and international standards, while supporting inspections, repair solutions, and quality procedures. Provides technical feedback, prepares inspection reports, and develops and implements required standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct incoming, in-process, and final inspections of rotating equipment and components.

• Prepare and review overhaul reports with technical recommendations.

• Develop work instructions, drawings, and repair methods based on findings.

• Maintain job packs, checklists, inspection records, and SOPs.

• Prepare and execute Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) with stakeholders.

• Provide technical quality support, including WPS/PQR review and material selection.

• Perform dimensional, geometric, and disassembly inspections.

• Manage NCRs, including RCA, CAPA, and lessons learned.

• Coordinate and oversee NDT and specialized testing with third parties.

• Ensure calibration, control, and traceability of inspection equipment.

• Support operations/projects, including progress updates and resolving technical issues.

• Train staff on quality standards and support LEAN and continuous improvement.

• Ensure compliance with EHS, quality procedures, and 5S practices.

• Promote a safe, clean, and positive work environment.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in a similar or related role

• Strong centrifugal pump background required; compressor/turbine experience is an advantage.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and technical specifications

• Experience in procedure development and NCR handling

• Proficient in precision measurement and workshop inspection

• Solid understanding of pump hydraulics, mechanical seals, and rotating equipment

• NDT certification (LPT/MPI/UT Level 2); LEAA lifting/rigging certification is a plus

• Knowledge of OEM standards and practices preferred

What we offer you

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• A great working environment.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:

About the role

Wir suchen einen Area Manager SEE (all genders) für unser Team in Österreich.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Aus- und Aufbau des Marktes in Südosteuropa für unsere technisch anspruchsvollen Produktgruppen

• Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungen unter Verwendung des gesamten Sulzer Produktportfolios

• Steigerung unserer Marktpräsenz in neuen Segmenten

• Betreuung unserer Key Accounts, sowie die Gewinnung neuer Kunden inklusive Budget- und Kostenverantwortung

• Angebotslegung, Auftragsverhandlung und -abschluss, Nachbereitung und technische Begleitung der Auftragsabwicklung

• Produktschulungen und Präsentationen bei unseren Händlern und Distributoren

Was Sie benötigen, um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein:

• Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (Lehre, HTL, FH, Uni), vorzugsweise in der Verfahren- oder Prozesstechnik, und konnten idealerweise schon 2-3 Jahre Praxis in einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit sammeln.

• Eine strukturierte, effiziente und terminorientierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit analytischem Denken und einer hohen Problemlösekompetenz zeichnen Sie aus.

• Sie punkten nicht nur mit ausgezeichneten Anwenderkenntnissen in MS-Office, sondern auch mit sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen und einem Führerschein der Klasse B.

• Ihre Teamfähigkeit, Verlässlichkeit und Belastbarkeit runden Ihr Profil ab.

What we offer you

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Freiheit, Vertrauen und Verantwortung für die Aufgaben, die Ihnen übertragen werden.

• Anhand unserer offenen und ehrlichen Kommunikation, die auf einer flachen Hierarchie und Du-Kultur basiert, schaffen wir ein angenehmes und humorvolles Arbeitsumfeld.

• Bedarfsorientierte fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sind uns wichtig.

• Eine faire Entlohnung (entsprechende Überzahlung zum Mindestgehalt lt. KV € 3.329,62 auf Basis Vollzeit), qualitativ hochwertige Arbeitsmaterialien, ein ansprechendes Sozialpaket sowie betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung zählen für uns zu den "Must-haves"

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

Nous recherchons un Area Manager SEE (tous genres) pour notre équipe en Autriche.

Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:

• Développer le marché en Europe du Sud-Est pour nos groupes de produits techniquement exigeants

• Développement de solutions durables utilisant l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Sulzer

• Accroître notre présence sur le marché de nouveaux segments

• Soutenir nos comptes clés et attirer de nouveaux clients, y compris le budget et la responsabilité des coûts

• Élimination, négociation et conclusion de contrats, rénovation et appui technique au traitement des contrats

• Formation et présentation de produits chez nos distributeurs et distributeurs

Ce que vous devez réussir dans ce rôle:

• Ils ont suivi une formation technique (enseignant, HTL, FH, université), de préférence en ingénierie de processus ou de processus, et ont été idéalement en mesure de rassembler 2-3 ans de pratique dans une activité comparable.

• Une façon de travailler structurée, efficace et axée sur le temps, combinée à la pensée analytique et à un haut niveau de compétence en résolution de problèmes, est ce que vous distinguez.

• Ils obtiennent non seulement une excellente connaissance de l'utilisateur dans MS-Office, mais aussi de très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais et un permis de conduire de classe B.

Ce que nous vous offrons:

• Liberté, confiance et responsabilité pour les tâches qui vous sont confiées.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. The ASM is assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. The ASM finds and develops sales opportunities and engages with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. The ASM will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the RSM. In this role, the ASM will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. ASMs engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. The ASM will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, the ASM will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. Responsibilities

• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line

• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line

• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer

• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line

• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client

• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing

• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts

• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities

• Control all business expenses as if they were your own

• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates

• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events

• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team

• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.

• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.

• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times.

Qualifications:

• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.

• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.

• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.

• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line

• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.

• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.

• The ASM is a leadership position that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines

• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills

• Understanding of basic financial statements

• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to use Sales

jobs.title: AP Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors.

Key Responsibilities

• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center

• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL

• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.

• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.

• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.

• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations.

Skills & Qualifications

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields

• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable

• Very good written and verbal communication skills

• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)

• Fluent English skills

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Winder Helper
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for assisting in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery under close supervision. This entry-level role supports senior mechanics in diagnosing issues, performing basic repairs, and ensuring equipment is safe and operational.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration. PASADENA, TEXAS, USA

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key 
• Responsibilities
Assist in inspecting and maintaining machinery and mechanical systems.
Perform basic repairs and part replacements.
Support preventive maintenance routines.
Clean and organize tools and work areas.
Follow safety procedures and report hazards.
Document maintenance activities.
Learn and apply mechanical troubleshooting techniques.

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols. Assembly Mechanic

Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We've been awarded a top employer nationwide for the past 3 years. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step!

We are looking for Assembly Mechanics to join our Core team in La Porte.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Safely and efficiently disassemble, thoroughly inspect, and precisely build rotating equipment such as steam turbines, gas turbines, compressors, hot gas expanders, gear boxes and other machinery according to Sulzer’s established guidelines and safety protocols.

• Conduct thorough visual inspections of disassembled components, identifying wear, damage, or abnormalities that may affect equipment performance.

• Utilize precision measuring instruments, such as micrometers, dial indicators, and bore gauges, to take accurate measurements and assess dimensional integrity of parts.

• Operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders, and forklifts when required.

• Prepare detailed inspection reports documenting findings and measurements.

• Execute unit assembly of repaired or replaced components, following technical specifications and quality standards.

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• 3 years of hands-on, shop oriented experience turbomachinery repair preferred.

• High mechanical aptitude and experience in detailed mechanic industries (turbines, compressors, rotating equipment)

• Willingness to work overtime when necessary.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• Bonus Programs

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: QESH Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The ESH Engineer is responsible for supporting basic environmental, safety, and health activities, including inspections, data collection, and compliance monitoring. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Pasadena, Texas, USA

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Stay updated with local, state, and federal QESH regulations.
· Prepare QESH permit applications and agreements as needed by regulatory agencies.
· Make sure branch stays compliant with ISO requirements.
· Maintain injury logs.
· Responsible for working with Divisional Safety to ensure all external, customer-related websites are current and that the company is in good standing (i.e.: ISNetworld, PIC, etc.).
· Maintain all Branch QESH related files.
· Enter all injuries into Intelex
· Send out notices and other correspondents as requested by Divisional Quality and SH and Environmental.
· Assist in writing Branch related Job Safety Analysis, Job Hazard Analysis and other safety related documents.
· Maintain and update all QESH related reference material.
· Conduct investigations of accidents, injuries and near misses to identify root causes and work with management to determine corrective and preventative actions so that such accidents might be prevented in the future.
· Conduct workplace inspections within the facility to endure compliance with company policies and procedures, safety and Quality standards and governmental regulations, including but not limited to ISO 9001, ISO 14001 AND ISO 45001.
· Assist with safety training and education programs.
· Responsibly for daily toolbox talks and weekly safety walks
· Assist with the company QESH manual updates and dissemination.
· Assist when needed in all corporate audits governing health, safety and Quality
· Maintain all calibration logs and make sure all equipment is calibrated in a timely manner
· Maintain QESH board
· Maintain Deviations and any other related quality paperwork needed for internal and external QESH audits.
· Generate environmental reports as requested by the Environmental Team.
· Work with the emergency response team to address environmental incidents such as chemical leaks and spills.
· Identify and solve any QESH violations.
· Conduct regular QESH inspections
· Oversee waste disposal and pollution control programs.

Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Knowledge in ISO 9001, ISO 14001 AND ISO 45001.

• Familiar with QESH policies in the manufacturing environment.

• Good computer skills.

Shift
Work hours are typically 7:30 until 4 pm

o Collaborate with service technicians, ASM’s and engineers to determine scope of work and timelines

jobs.title: Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Repair various kinds of electro-mechanical equipment. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

RESPONSIBILTIES

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.

• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.

• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.

• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.

• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.

• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).

• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.

• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic mechanical aptitude

• Ability to understand, perform and retain various skill related training and operational and safety procedures demonstrated by supervisor.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

jobs.title: Welder
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job. Maintain and repair all machinery. Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

Responsibilities

• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)

• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Knowledge and understand of electro machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• Must have 3 years or more of proven welding experience.

Physical Demands:

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors. Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes. PHOENIX, ARIZONA, USA

• Maintain proper training certification (GTAW, SMAW, SAW, GTAW Aluminum, etc.)

• Be capable of reading all prints issued to welding department

• Accurately follow welding instructions to provide quality welds within the appropriate approved methods

• Ability to use and operate overhead cranes, torches, grinders and forklifts

• Work closely and communicate clearly with the other departments, Weld personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man

Qualifications:
The ideal candidate will possess the following:

• Knowledge and understand of electro machinery repair.

• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks.

• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments.

• Must be able to work overtime when necessary.

• Must have 3 years or more of proven welding experience.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead Machine Operator is responsible for overseeing the operation of machinery and equipment on the production floor, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to safety and quality standards. This role provides guidance to other machine operators and supports troubleshooting and maintenance activities.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. The following job description and duties are not meant to be all encompassing of the assigned duties. Due to business demands, job duties are variable by nature and subject to revisions, additions or deletions as may be determined and directed by Management or Supervision.
SUMMARY:
Sets up and operates machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore, without assistance, following department policy and procedures manual, to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. Interprets mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and performs precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. Measures components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Works under limited supervision.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
· Performs layouts, sets up, and operates conventional machine tools as required
· Reads and interprets all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing
· Designs setups and methods where none exist
· Instructs other shop personnel in proper machining techniques
· Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs
QUALIFICATIONS:
· Completion of a machinist apprentice program or hands on training
.G code programming is a plus
· Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections
· Demonstrated ability to effectively set up all, or at least most, of the following machines: I.D./O.D. Grinder, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Knee Mill, Radial Drill, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, and Planer Mill
· Ability to perform with a minimum of direct supervision
· Working knowledge of tool geometry and application
· Working knowledge of effects of feeds and speeds
·At least 4 years experience in machine shops on the above equipment

· Ability to work overtime as required

· While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

jobs.title: LAUNCH Program (Rotational)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:

• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.

This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:

• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.
